In France, an American female attorney (A.J. Cook) defends a murder suspect who has a brutish appearance and a deadly secret.

A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.
A family tries to start over following a daughter's release from a mental health institution.
The Munsters are invited to a masquerade dance party to meet the family of Marilyn's beau.
Lily and Herman find themselves the unwelcome targets of amorous advances made by their nosy neighbors; Grandpa's love potion affects the wrong people.
Herman is mistaken for a monster when he takes a walk in the local park.
Herman and Grandpa mistakenly think that Lily is pregnant.
Hysterical gas company workers inform their boss of the Munsters' existence.
Herman embarks on a crash diet after he is invited to an Army reunion and discovers he can't squeeze into his uniform.
Eddie's science project, a robot, malfunctions.
Herman attempts to earn money for Eddie's college education by moonlighting as a pro wrestler.
Mónica atormenta a Belén porque se entregó a Aurelio, y le sentencia que su calvario apenas comienza. Casillas quiere volver con Robles, mientras el Chema exige a Rutila que seduzca a Rivero.
Mónica se niega a volver con Aurelio, quien confiesa que siente miedo y culpabilidad por la muerte de la esposa de Víctor. Morejón no acepta el ultimátum que los Emes le enviaron con Ignacio.
Aurelio y Tim arreglan sus cuentas a golpes. Rawlings le propone que se convierta en el mayor lavador de dinero del mundo, y también le pide que elimine al Güero, su obstáculo en la DEA.
Aurelio se reúne en Panamá con Esperanza, su nueva socia, cuya belleza y audacia lo atrapan. El Güero negocia con Tim: le dice que le irá mejor que con Rivero y le pregunta quién es su protegido.
Aurelio cae en los brazos de Esperanza y su amiga. Rivero ordena investigar los negocios de Rutila, mientras ella roba información de su computadora, a pedido del Chema. Omar alerta a Mónica.
Aurelio les dice a sus socios que ahora se dedica al lavado de dinero y Víctor queda en su lugar. Por orden de Rivero, allanan el local de Rutila y Mónica, y hallan químicos para fabricar éxtasis.
Víctor se enfrenta a Carreño y mata a uno de sus hombres: jura que eliminará al general venezolano la próxima vez que le diga traidor a su tío. Feyo le confiesa a la Condesa que asesinó a Juan.
Tijeras ataca con una bazuca a Eleazar y al general Jaramillo, y escapa cuando el ejército llega a su finca. Feyo mata a Justino y hace creer que fueron los Emes. Belén lo defiende ante Leonor.
Mónica necesita que Aurelio le consiga la droga para sus socios, pero él le pone como condición que mate al Güero. Andrews le comunica a Tim que queda frente a la DEA y está bajo sus órdenes.
Belén quiere escapar con Aurelio: sabe que Feyo mató a Justino y teme ser la próxima víctima. Los Emes atacan a Feyo, pero él cree que fue Aurelio. Víctor sigue a Mónica hasta la casa de Chema.
Silvestre intenta abusar de Leonor en casa de Elisa, pero Aurelio la salva de nuevo. Ballesteros no dice quién la rescató de las manos del violador. Víctor conoce el plan de Mónica y la sigue.
Secuestran a Luzma y sus amigos, pero Morejón ordena rescatarlos sanos y salvos. Mónica va a casa del Güero para cumplir con el encargo de Aurelio. Antes, Leonor le presenta a Andrews su renuncia.
Víctor ayuda a Mónica con el encargo, y Leonor es la sospechosa de la muerte del Güero. Aurelio culpa a Rutila por el secuestro de Luzma, mientras Ignacio descubre que es hija de Casillas.
Luzma le dice a sus amigos que su papá los va a rescatar, mientras que Morejón se entera de que Luciana es amiga de la hija de Aurelio. Leonor enfrenta a Tim: lo acusa de la muerte del Güero.
Casillas llega al lugar donde mataron a Richie, mientras Luzma ruega a los secuestradores que negocien con su papá. El Chema y el Toro descubren que Julia es la esposa de Tim y deciden matarla.
El secuestrador hace que Marcado vaya por Luzma, a cambio de trabajar con Aurelio. Rutila se entera de que su hermanita consume metanfetaminas. Morejón le pide a Rivero que retome su cargo.
Aurelio rescata a Luzma y se enfrenta a Marcado, pero el violador de Rutila escapa. Padre e hija viajan a Michoacán, al rancho de Feyo. Morejón deja en manos de Rivero la rendición de los Emes.
Aurelio y Belén se aman con pasión, mientras doña Alba cae en los brazos de Feyo. La hija y el yerno de Aguilera descubren la infidelidad. Morejón se entera de que Casillas liberó a los muchachos.
El Toro le dispara a Julia, quien muere en los brazos de Tim. Leonor escucha que la asesinaron para vengar al Güero y acusa a Rawlings. Rutila desespera y decide ir a la guerra contra el Chema.
El Chema impide a la fuerza que Rutila escape con su hijo, mientras Víctor promete no dejar sola a su prima. Feyo y doña Alba siguen juntos, y Luzma le dice a Belén que está enamorada de su papá.
Feyo llega al rancho, y su hija le dice que Belén le monta cuernos con Aurelio. Casillas pide luz verde a Rutila para matar al Chema; también le da pautas a Tim para vengar la muerte de Julia.
Feyo estalla de la rabia; le tiende una trampa a Belén para que vaya a casa de Justino y, delante de Aurelio, la amenaza de muerte. Ignacio le pide ayuda a Leonor para liberar a su asistente.
Feyo degüella y manda a enterrar a Belén ante los ojos de Aurelio, y le exige que pida perdón por ensuciar a la mujer que amaba. Casillas se va con Luzma de Michoacán tras la amenaza de Aguilera.
Mónica le dice a Aurelio que no lo quiere ver más, y él les propone a ella y a Esperanza que hagan una despedida los tres. Feyo dice en su rancho que Belén no regresará y prohíbe hablar de ella.
Morejón tiene problemas de bebida, y su esposa y colaboradores están preocupados. Aurelio sufre un fuerte dolor por deficiencia renal. Mónica negocia con Esperanza a espaldas de Casillas.
Víctor y Mónica hacen el amor; él no olvida a Chabela, pero quiere que lo ayude a no pensar en ella. Aurelio y Tim buscan un culpable del asesinato de Andrews, y Rivero detiene a Leonor.

Cristina, drogada, entra a la fuerza a casa de Víctor, donde Mónica la enfrenta. Furiosa, la periodista le dice a Rutila que se vengará. Leonor no resistiría estar de nuevo presa, y Omar le propone huir.
Desesperada, Mónica le pide ayuda a Omar para huir con su hijo, luego de confesarle a doña Alba que Aurelio es culpable de la muerte de Isabel. Morejón acusa a Ignacio del atentado a Monteverde.
Doña Alba reconoce que Aurelio es un criminal y está decidida a matarlo. Leonor se enfrenta a tiros con Mónica frente al edificio de Omar. Feyo y Casillas viajan a Cancún, dispuestos a vengarse.
Silvestre Dangond hace un recorrido íntimo por más de 20 años de trayectoria artística.

Piso 21 habla sobre su álbum "TRESCENDER", su encuentro con David Beckham y Marc Anthony, y cómo han logrado sobrevivir en la industria musical tras dejar Colombia, evolucionando su sonido y manteniéndose vigentes en la música latina.

Toña recibe las invitaciones para la boda de Miranda. Las posibilidades de que Paco detenga la boda para no perder a su amor.
Paco y Miranda comienzan con terapia de pareja. La terapeuta se muestra más preocupada por la relación con Frank.
Los integrantes en peligro de eliminación se enfrentan en retos de agua y fuego para permanecer en la competencia y evitar irse para siempre.
Jymel descubre a Lehder. Lehder alardea de una nueva ruta. Lewis cada vez está más cerca de Lehder.

Greg se encuentra prisionero en su propia casa. Pau y Beto tienen una pelea. Mientras está en recuperación, Iván decide hacer lo correcto. Samuel vive un momento revelador con David. Maya tiene un encuentro cercano con una figura misteriosa.

Idoia e Itzi son detenidas y acusadas de asesinato y Mario decide intervenir para liberarlas de la cárcel. En México, Chelo sostiene un terrible enfrentamiento con su marido tras el que necesitará toda la ayuda que su amiga Rosa pueda prestarle.
Una empresaria de modas con una enfermedad que le desfigura la cara se une a un científico loco para secuestrar mujeres jóvenes.

Magdalena recibe la carta de un exnovio, imagina que es millonario y lo llama para averiguar si es cierto. Frankie sospecha que en el edificio hay un ladrón que se lleva sus libretos y culpa a Germán.
Magdalena corre el chisme de que Silvia tuvo una cita con un hombre mayor. Silvia desmiente el rumor y les confiesa a todos que pronto se casará.
Albertano y Vítor deciden cambiar su apariencia drásticamente para conquistar mujeres, pero optan por volver a su vida normal después de ver que el plan no funciona.
Vítor y Albertano se emocionan porque participarán en el juego final de su equipo del barrio y les piden ayuda a Natacha y Cuca para entrenar, pues son muy malos jugadores.

Durante su visita a la farmacia, la tía Licha es confundida con una doctora y se consigue una credencial falsa para recetar medicamentos. Don Justo condiciona el regreso de Plácido a su empresa a cambio de que le deje su cama para poder dormir.
Don Justo soborna a Justito y a Victoria para que no le digan a la familia que tiene dinero escondido. Enrique Durán, un antiguo amor de Renta, regresa para tratar de conquistarla de nuevo.

La madrastra de un chico quiere deshacerse de él para poder quedarse con la herencia que su abuela le dejó. El padre del chico lo corre de la casa, pero él logra salir adelante gracias a un profesor de su escuela.
Un hombre se entera del terrible y doloroso pasado de su esposa tras su muerte. La suegra del hombre le pide que la ayude a cumplir el último deseo de su hija, encontrar al hijo que le arrebataron.
El papá de Coral, Azul y Perla trata de emparejarlas con los hijos de sus amigos para formar una alianza. No obstante, ellas tratarán de escapar de la decisión de su padre.
Roberta está dispuesta a hacer cualquier cosa por tener un bebé para evitar que su marido se divorcie de ella. La joven Azucena parece ser su opción.
Benjamín e Itzel dicen "te amo" por primera vez. Leona les dice a David y Gael que no está embarazada. Leona, Consuelo e Itzel comienzan a sofocarse, debido a la llave de gas que Jeremías abrió.

Rosario le confiesa a Alejandro que es su madre y él se arrepiente de correrla de su casa. Montserrat le entrega a Alejandro la prueba de paternidad que confirma que él es el padre de su hijo y le pide que firme el divorcio.

Alejandro sale de la cárcel y visita a José Luis para preguntarle si fue amante de su esposa y él le dice la verdad. Dimitrio se entera del engaño de Graciela y sospecha que es hijo de Benjamín Almonte.
Aída le dice a Rubén que su relación con Mariano ya es formal. Hernán le pide a Esperanza que acepte su ayuda. Amadeo le cuenta a Mayra que Rubén hizo un fraude en sus empresas.

Juana termina con Héctor por ocultarle que Vanessa regresó. Luisa organiza una cena romántica para Fernando. Rubén tiene miedo de que Mayra descubra que le robó porque se llevó todos los documentos de sus empresas a su casa.

Doña Chana le asegura a Ana Lucía que hay otras dos mujeres idénticas a ella. Soledad se pone nerviosa porque se reencuentra con Santiago, ya que antes de perder la memoria, él descubrió la verdad sobre Ana Lucía.
Bernardo le pide a Carmen que sea su esposa. Renata trata de convencer a Guillermo de comprarle un departamento a Mónica para deshacerse de ella y sus amigas.
Damián le confiesa al padre Guadalupe que él no le disparó a Gabino. Ingrid le pide a Damián que no diga que fue ella quien disparó el arma.
Soledad le prohíbe a Ana Lucía ir a Santa Cecilia para evitar que sepa sobre su pasado. Mariano le pide perdón a Jennifer por haberle sido infiel.
Carmen se alegra por el arresto de Vicente, pues sabe que ahora no podrá quitarle a Claudio. Verónica echa a Guillermo y Renata de su casa para defender a Mónica.
Ingrid confiesa su crimen y jura que no lo hizo a propósito. Carmina le dice a Begoña que Ingrid no se puede casar con Edmundo porque está casada con Gabino.
Gael le pide a Leona que se casen lo más pronto posible. Apolo le pide a Josefa una nueva oportunidad de estar juntos. Leona por poco les revela a Ana Julia y Benjamín que es su mamá.
Irma busca pretextos para no regresar a casa, pero Luigi insiste en llevarla; Omar le dice a Fernando que no le gusta nada el hecho de que Lety haya desaparecido.

Luigi le pide a Irma que le cuente la historia de su vida con Rafael; Carolina se molesta con Lety porque le dice que quiere regresar a la ciudad; Lety se encuentra un anillo y hace un ritual con el mar.

Fernando mira con tristeza la oficina de Lety. Aldo le cuenta a Lety por qué se distanció de su padre y le dice que ve en ella un corazón con mucho dolor. Julieta se niega a darle a Fernando información sobre Lety.
Irmita les da noticias a sus compañeros de trabajo: el doctor dice que Rafael puede morir en cualquier momento.

Aldo le dice a Carolina lo sorprendido que está con el cambio de Lety. Marcia se molesta al saber que Lety salió de la ciudad y se burla de Fernando, pero él le confirma que está enamorado de Leticia.
Fernando se molesta con Omar y le pide que deje de ponerle apodos denigrantes a Leticia; Lety ayuda a las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza a repasar sus conocimientos generales.
Las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza le agradecen a Lety por darles confianza y Aldo la felicita por compartir lo que aprendió con él; Jorge le hace una visita a Rafael.
Tomás se niega a decirle a Julieta por qué Lety abrió Filmo Imagen y embargó a Conceptos; Teresita le pide a Marcia no darse por vencida con Fernando.

Aldo le confiesa a Lety que su padre se molestó con él por convertirse en chef en lugar de ingeniero y ella le expresa su admiración por ser fiel a sus ideales; Fernando busca a Lety en el bar de un hotel.
Fernando está desesperado sin Leticia; Lety le confiesa a Aldo que no puede dejar de pensar en Fernando.

Carolina le dice a Lety que Aldo está encantado con ella. Aldo lleva a Lety a bucear y navegar. Irma presenta a su familia en Conceptos. Rebeca le informa a Luigi que quiere llevarse a Irma a Estados Unidos. Tomás acude de nuevo a la junta de Comité.
Mónica le cuenta a Marcia que vio a Fernando muy borracho en un bar y que el barman lo estaba mandando a su casa en taxi; Marcia, a su vez, se lo cuenta a Teresita y ella se aflige mucho.

Jessica le dice a Carolina que su miedo desapareció gracias a los consejos de Lety. Marcia le cuenta a Alicia que Fernando confesó estar enamorado de Lety. Aldo lleva a Lety en motocicleta por el puerto de Acapulco.
Fernando le llama la atención a Alicia por no pasarle las llamadas y la molesta por la relación que tuvo con Tomás; Teresita le propone a Marcia una alianza para sacar adelante Conceptos.

Omar le dice a Teresita quién es el dueño de Conceptos; Simón le dice a Teresita y Marcia que Fernando salió de la empresa en muy malas condiciones; Fernando se estaciona enfrente de la lancha de Aldo.
Fernando es sacado de un bar todo golpeado, pero logra volver a entrar; Lety interviene entre Aldo y Fausto para que se reconcilien; Fausto le entrega a Aldo una carta.
Lety le cuenta a Carolina que pasó toda la noche con Aldo y se dieron un beso, por lo que ya no quiere volverlo a ver; Carolina le aconseja darse una oportunidad con Aldo.

Aldo le pide ayuda a Lety para cocinar para las concursantes del certamen Nuestra Belleza; Lety le pide no hablar de lo que pasó entre ellos; Fernando le confiesa a Omar haber ido a Acapulco para que lo mataran.
Omar y Fernando hablan a la casa de la familia Padilla, pero Julieta les cuelga; las del cuartel, en compañía de Paco, Celso, Simón y Raúl, ven el certamen Nuestra Belleza por televisión.
Fernando llega a la residencia de Jorge Flores, quien le da una fórmula para eliminar la tristeza y las angustias, con el fin de volver a ser el mismo de antes, en armonía.
En la junta del comité, don Humberto anuncia que llegó a un acuerdo con don Erasmo para solo meter abogados en lo que concierne a la devolución de la empresa.
Sara coquetea con Sánchez y Rosales. Don Erasmo habla con Julieta y Tomás del acuerdo al que llegó con don Humberto. Los licenciados Sánchez y Rosales se presentan ante la junta de comité.
Lety le dice a Tomás que ya perdonó a Fernando. El licenciado Santa María propone un plan para salvar Conceptos, pero Lety es la única que puede ayudarlos.
Marcia se disculpa con Fernando y le promete dejar de insistir en el tema de Lety. Por otra parte, Lety le comparte a Tomás lo que aprendió con Aldo.
Celso no deja a Lety entrar a Conceptos; Paula María se molesta al enterarse de que Simón llevó a Alicia a su casa en la motocicleta; Lola se niega a conciliar con Efrén por la presencia de Jazmín.
Teresita le pide a Marcia que se presente en la sala de juntas; las del cuartel comentan la reacción de Marcia al ver a Lety.
Aldo sigue a Lety hasta un autobús y se sube detrás de ella; Fernando se encuentra al vidente en un restaurante y recibe premoniciones sobre Lety y Marcia.
El licenciado Sánchez acepta darle seguimiento al divorcio de Lola; Alicia le coquetea al licenciado Santa María, pero no logra salir con él porque Rosales insiste en salir con ella.
Omar le aconseja a Fernando reconquistar a Lety para que no se queden en la calle; Alicia se porta muy raro con Leticia, quien le pide a Marcia poner en claro su relación laboral.

Peter braves a blizzard for a remote farm call; Cynthia the goat needs help; Emily the cat wobbles; Digz survives a hit-and-run; Katie seeks Peter's aid in an urgent caesarean.
Peter must neuter an over-amorous chinchilla; Rodney contemplates euthanizing his sheepdog, Millie; a biting monitor lizard; a pig not as micro as advertised.

Peter aids a cow with a prolapsed uterus and meets elderly cat Sawsa; Julian assists Chris with pig insemination; Betty worries over Billy's health issues.

Peter helps a struggling Wendy the wallaby, while Julian performs urgent surgery to save Griff the terrier; Julian pregnancy tests a pedigree herd, which reveals Lawrence the bull might have a problem; an eye-watering test should reveal the truth.

Peter meets his trickiest client yet, Possum the uber-angry pussycat; Julian examines Nykee the alpaca, who may have a life-threatening and excruciatingly painful condition; Flynn, a working sheepdog, has a suspected broken leg.

Brothers Kyle and Peter Reynolds were raised to believe that their dad died when they were young. They're shocked to discover that their mother lied about his death because she never knew who the biological father was. Setting out on an epic quest to find him, the two siblings soon learn more about their mom's past than they ever wanted to know.

Nick is a pizza deliverer who lives a fairly ordinary, boring life -- until he crosses paths with two aspiring criminal masterminds, who kidnap him, strap a bomb to his chest and force him to rob a bank for them. Nick doesn't get much time to pull off the difficult task, so he enlists the aid of Chet, his estranged pal. As time ticks away, Nick and Chet face many obstacles, not the least of which is their volatile relationship.

Kurapika meets up with Gon and Killua; Kurapika reveals his Nen ability; Chrollo reads the future of Troupe members.

The game Greed Island is finally on the auction block; Gon and Killua ask the purchaser to hire them as players, but they're told that their Nen is too weak; they begin to work on special abilities so they can be selected as players.
Gon and Killua want to be Greed Island players, but must demonstrate their Nen to a judge to land one of the 32 available spots.
Gon and Killua enter the world of Greed Island in hopes of finding Ging.
Gon and Killua encounter tough monsters as their quest for spell cards leads them toward Masadora; a mysterious girl named Biscuit observes the two as they fight.
When Biscuit defeats Binolt, Gon and Killua ask her to be their master.
Gon and Killua continue to improve their Nen and work together to gather more monster cards; Bisky advances them to the final stage of their training.
Gon develops a new technique based on rock-paper-scissors; Killua must leave Greed Island temporarily to take the Hunter Exam, leaving Gon and Bisky to deal with Genthru.
With Killua back, the three hunters resume collecting cards, but they still face adversaries who intend to beat them to the goal.
After deceiving Team Tsezguerra, Team Genthru has 96 restricted card slots; Gon and Killua try to stop Genthru from winning by monopolizing Path of Shore.
Gon and his friends make it to Soufrabi and challenge the pirate boss, Razor, to a team sports battle; the hunters head to Aiai, "The City of Love."
Gon, Hisoka and Goreinu challenge Razor; Razor challenges them to dodgeball.
Gon is sent to the outfield; he needs Killua's help to defeat Razor.
Gon, Killua and Hisoka must catch Razor's strongest throw in order to be crowned the dodgeball winner.
Hisoka seeks a Nen user with a unique power; Tsezguerra tries to beat Genthru to win the game; Gon keeps training as Killua gives his hands a rest.

After Team Tsezguerra leaves the game, Mr. Battera reveals the true purpose behind why he purchased so many Greed Island games; Genthru approaches Team Gon to propose a deal for the two remaining cards they require.
Gon faces Genthru alone and makes a last-minute change to his team's plan that risks utter defeat; another game must take place for the last #00 card.
Gon and his friends finally defeat Genthru and collect 99 trading cards.
Gon and Killua head out to meet someone who they hope is Ging; Gon arrives, the man starts yelling at them.
Gon and Killua decide to join Kite and his team in their research mission gathering information on the Chimera Ants.
Kite has narrowed down the location of the Chimera Ants.

In April 1999, Jotaro Kujo travels to the town of Morioh to find a man named Higashikata, the newest JoJo, and comes across a freshman being accosted by upstart students.

Josuke spots villain Angelo's Stand and tells Jotaro, who deduces the Stand can somehow enter people, so he warns Josuke to not eat or drink anything until he can reach him; Josuke witnesses the Stand go into his mother.

Angelo's Stand ability seems connected to DIO; after defeating Angelo, Jotaro tries to find the whereabouts of the bow and arrow related to the Stand; Koichi finds trouble when he walks home with Josuke.

To save Koichi, Josuke goes further into the Nijimura household; he manages to dodge an attack, but it hits Okuyasu, and Josuke offers to heal his wounds if he reveals the identity of his brother's Stand.
Josuke and Koichi defeat Keicho and continue their mission to destroy the bow and arrow; when they hear strange noises in a dark room, they enter into another fight.

Riding his bike to school, Koichi accidentally runs over a bag with a cat inside, killing it; a man appears and demands money from the regretful boy, saying that he'll use it to bury the cat, but the situation only gets worse.

Josuke and Koichi hear from Tamami that a high school student named Hazamada might also be a Stand user, so the two go to the school and investigate; Josuke checks inside Hazamada's locker and finds a strange wooden doll that attacks them.

Koichi's classmate Yukako Yamagishi asks him out, but his joy turns to worry when she unexpectedly loses her temper with him, then performs several acts of generosity for him the next day; as Yukako's obsession worsens, she does the unthinkable.

Koichi plans to escape from Yukako by having Reverb find a payphone and contact Josuke and Okuyasu, but Yukako stays one step ahead of him; as Koichi begins to lose hope, Yukako goes to the phone and something unexpected happens.

Josuke and Okuyasu visit a new Italian restaurant where the chef, Tonio, decides what the customer will eat instead of offering a menu; Tonio offers Okuyasu water that has an unexpected effect on him.

Chili Pepper shows himself to Josuke; he seems to be more powerful than Jotaro, and he can travel anywhere electricity flows; Jotaro summons Josuke, Okuyasu and Koichi and tells them a certain someone approaches Morioh.
Jotaro believes Chili Pepper will try to kill Joseph Joestar by attacking his boat, so he leaves Josuke and Koichi to defend the harbor; Josuke deals with his conflicting feelings toward Joseph.

Josuke and the others capture Akira Otoishi and safely retrieve the bow and arrow, restoring peace to Morioh, but Josuke still can't seem to get closer to the father he just met, Joseph; they discuss Josuke's mother, then discover another Stand user.

Koichi and Hazamada learn famous manga artist Rohan Kishibe lives in town, and they go to get an autograph; Rohan thrills the boys by offering a tour of his studio, but Koichi becomes frightened when he sees just how far Rohan takes his work.

Koichi sneaks into Rohan's house and finds Rohan drawing manga at an incredible speed; Rohan can't stop himself from drawing after reading about Koichi's experiences, and he attempts to take another page from Koichi by using Heaven's Door.

Jotaro unexpectedly invites Josuke to accompany him on a hunt for the rat that gained Stand abilities after Akira Otoishi shot it with the bow and arrow; they trace the rat by discovering strange evidence of the power it wields.

Koichi and Rohan discover an alley not listed on any map and decide to explore it, but when they unexpectedly find themselves back where they started with no exit in sight, Rohan suspects a Stand user trapped them.

Josuke encounters a tiny Stand holding a coin and follows it to a new Stand user named Shigekiyo Yangyu, who sends his Stand to pick up all the loose change around town; Josuke comes up with a better use for Shigekiyo's Stand.

Josuke and the others head to the bank with their lottery ticket, but the bank clerk suspects foul play since someone else's name and phone number are written on the back; when he decides to call the number, Josuke takes desperate action.

A depressed Yukako sees a mysterious shop called Salon Cinderella that creates faces to bring people fortune; she receives a new face that allows her to find love and discovers how well it works during a chance meeting with Koichi.
When Shigechi accidentally takes Kira's sandwich bag by mistake, Kira chases after him.

Jotaro and Koichi try to track down the owner of the button and run into the murderer, Yoshikage Kira, and his Stand; Koichi ignores Jotaro's order and decides to face Kira on his own.

Josuke and the others head to Kira's house to learn more about him; they make some creepy discoveries until a camera on Kira's desk suddenly takes a picture.

Yoshihiro steals the bow and arrow and looks for people to turn into Stand users to protect his son; Rohan looks for Kira, hoping to find him before he tries to kill off his new family; a strange boy interrupts Rohan and challenges him to a game.
Kira, living as Kosaku Kawajiri, struggles to control his urge to kill, finally snapping when he sees Shinobu's neck; Josuke and Okuyasu encounter a strange person in the middle of a crop circle.
Rohan catches onto Josuke's attempt to cheat him at cee-lo, but when he can't prove it, he cuts off his own pinky and declares that he'll take Josuke's pinky too if he can figure out Josuke's trick.
Jotaro tries to find the mysterious footprint Stand's user, racing around on his motorcycle for a phone to call Koichi for help while the mysterious Stand continues to chase him.

Yoshihiro finds Kira, still posing as Kawajiri, and sees through the disguise; he spots Hayato videotaping him and takes action, knowing the boy might lead Rohan and Jotaro to his son; Josuke and Okuyasu find a man living up on an unused pylon.

Architect Masazo Kinoto shows up at Rohan's house to calculate the estimate for the fire damage and restoration and Rohan can't help but wonder about Kinoto's odd obsession; Josuke fights Kanedaichi again to save a trapped Mikitaka.

Rohan gets a look at Kinoto's back, inadvertently causing his death and unleashing the Stand Cheap Trap, which attaches to his back; Josuke and Fungami look for Koichi and encounter a young man whose Stand can trap anyone inside pieces of paper.

A skeptical Koichi declines to help Rohan because he refuses to show Koichi the Stand on his back, for fear of dying; Rohan must carefully make his way to the Morioh Grand Hotel for help without exposing his back; Hayato witnesses Kira commit murder.

Josuke and Hayato try to force Deadly Queen and Stray Cat into close-quarters combat by going into a nearby house, but air bullets persistently target Josuke, keeping him on the defensive.

A British landlord offers free rent to a woman if she'll take care of his troublesome tenants.
A serial killer crisscrosses the country, murdering victims with pre-stashed weapons and tools he calls "kill kits."
When the soon-to-be ex-wife of a prominent investment banker dies inside her Arizona home, law enforcement rules out an accidental death.
A destitute criminal terrorizes central Florida, robbing middle-aged men, executing them and disposing of their dead bodies in random wooded areas.
A mentally unstable man goes on a two-hour shooting spree, killing one man and wounding two others.
A gunman attempts to take out an entire family, one by one, as they enter their house.
When a husband and his pregnant wife get shot while leaving a child birthing class, police originally call it a random act of violence.
After three members of an affluent family get murdered inside their home, law enforcement locks in on a primary person of interest.
Authorities find a serial killer living among the bodies of his victims, which he stashed inside his home.
A killer terrorizes South Los Angeles during the 1980s, then appears to go dormant for 14 years, only to resurface in the most hideous way possible.
A woman's clairvoyant dream leads police in coastal Florida to a dead body on a beach.
A serial killer crisscrosses the state of California, leaving a trail of dead bodies in random locations.
A serial predator leaves a trail of dead bodies along the Southeastern United States; investigators find a key piece of evidence that reveals the killer's identity.
The disappearance of a wealthy retiree in South Florida quickly turns from a missing person's case to a homicide investigation.
The killing of a man inside his suburban Los Angeles home sets off a chain reaction of murder and conspiracy.
Law enforcement investigates a series of unsolved murders in the state of Colorado and discover that the seemingly isolated incidents all point to a single FBI informant.
A triple homicide in a small town in Maine rocks the community and destroys a family; a cover-up points to a perpetrator close to home.
A disgruntled man goes on a killing spree, terrorizing the borough of Brooklyn, N.Y.; police track the killer for more than 24 hours before finally zeroing in on him.
Four young adults are gunned down inside an affluent home in a quiet suburb of Houston, Texas; Police chase down hundreds of leads before finding a killer with a convoluted motive.
Murder inside a Beverly Hills, Calif., mansion sparks a highly publicized investigation; law enforcement uncovers the secrets of a family in deep turmoil.
The discovery of a burned body on the side of the road in suburban Dallas starts a furious race to find a killer.
The relationship between a teenage girl, her boyfriend, and the girl's mother results in premeditated murder.
The random murder of a woman in Central Montana sends law enforcement on the hunt for a killer; using a network of informants, authorities track down a mentally unstable man.
When a heartbroken millionaire marries a much younger woman, the marriage ends in murder.
Police in Texas investigate a brutal killing at a construction site; after a massive process of elimination, detectives finally track down a suspect.
A killer with an unforgettable nickname terrorizes New York City in the late 1970s; a series of letters, a reluctant witness, and a parking ticket lead to an arrest.
Police in rural Minnesota investigate the murder of a missing woman whose body was dumped next to an abandoned farmhouse.
When an axe-wielding murderer savagely attacks a husband and wife in their Upstate New York home, the wife survives, but loses her memory of the attack.
After assaults on three different women leave one killed, Boston police use surveillance video and witness reports to find a suspect.
A transient turned serial killer uses Louisiana's capital city as his hunting ground, leaving a trail of dead women over a three-year span.
Police investigate the brutal murder of a recent widower inside his North Dakota home and find evidence of the suspect's desperate plan.
When women in a working-class Rhode Island town begin mysteriously disappearing, police discover the dark obsession of a serial killer.
A man turns Cleveland, Ohio, into a hunting ground as part of a twisted plot to exact revenge on the women who hurt him.
A triple homicide in New Orleans, La., leaves law enforcement with puzzling clues that must be pieced together to solve the mystery.
The murder of a grandmother in the suburbs of Cincinnati, Ohio sends a small-town police department on a hunt for the killer.
In Southern California, law enforcement hunt for a serial killer who is preying on elderly women; after weeks of investigating, a survivor comes forward with a description.
A killer in Southern Louisiana gets away with murder for nearly a decade, until a potential victim escapes and leads police to the killer's doorstep.
A young Southern California woman vanishes without a trace; after years of investigation, a random encounter leads to new clues.
Authorities try to determine the identity of a dead woman found underneath a New Jersey bridge; a combination of forensic evidence and eyewitness accounts help bring the killer to justice.
The murder of a respected college professor shocks a suburban Richmond, Va. community; as authorities investigate, the killer's premeditated plot is revealed.
Police in northern Montana rush to rescue a kidnapped college student; it takes NASA technology for law enforcement to uncover the identity of the abductor.
When a Las Vegas casino worker is murdered, the investigation reveals a conspiracy.
Aaron Hernandez goes from the football record books to life in prison for murder; a former stripper is accused in her husband's brutal death.
A prison inmate attacks more than 20 guards and countless prisoners, and takes 11 hostages; the largest online manhunt to date.
Amber and Kareem look to find a luxury home that's closer to his office and near the beach in the Irvine, Newport and Laguna Beach areas; Kareem primarily wants to move closer to work.
James and Tricia house hunt around Encino, Calif.; will they find their forever home?

Christine and Kirk search for their dream beach home; Viviana takes them through three modern showstoppers on the west side of Los Angeles, Calif.; Christine and Kirk need a home with enough room for them and their dogs.
Pamela and William delve into the community of Sherman Oaks, aiming to find a character-filled home that captures their hearts.
Retirees Steve and Yazmin look for a luxury property in Orange County, Calif., visiting three homes in Yorba Linda, Villa Park and Santa Ana.
Mish is on the lookout for her forever home; she is looking for a home perfect for entertaining.
Selena is looking to move closer to Silicon Valley; she's visiting some of the most desirable properties in Saratoga, Calif.
Cory is looking to surprise his wife with their dream home; Viviana takes him through three properties in Los Angeles; Cory and his wife need enough room to grow their family.
Arica and Sean are relocating from San Francisco; they're visiting some desirable properties in Orange County, Calif.
Serena is leaving Seattle for life on the beach; she's visiting some desirable properties in Manhattan Beach, Calif.
Gea and David look for their dream home with more space in Cupertino, Calif.
Steve and Linda escape the cold of the East Coast and hunt for their sunny hideaway in Los Angeles; will they find their winter escape?
Sydney and Ralph find enough room for them and their fur baby; only the hills of Pasadena have the answer.
George and Bill are looking to cut their commute and move to the city; they visit some desirable properties in Palo Alto, Calif.
John and Laura search for a luxury home; Viviana taking them through some of the most beautiful mega mansions in Montecito, California.
Home buyers Alex and Rose tour three luxury properties in Orange County, Calif.

Meet Fleet Easton, the crown prince of Palm Springs; he's a singer and dancer who has worked hard and is now ready to buy his dream home; join us to see which one of these desert dwellings will seal the deal.

Clair and Monte are looking for an entertainer's home by the beach; Viviana takes them through three properties in Manhattan Beach; Claire and Monte want a home that is close to their friends and suits their lifestyle.
Meeting Dee and her friend Terry; Dee is looking for a luxury home for her family and growing business; Viviana takes her through some homes around Los Angeles.
Rami wants to surprise his fiancée with a brand-new home; Viviana takes him through three wonderful homes in Silicon Valley, California.
Following Samantha and Julian in their house hunt; they need a house with a lot of room to entertain in.
Hiram and Julissa look for a larger family home in Orange County, Calif.; he wants something modern, while she wants something traditional.
Luxury home buyers Kyle and Jess tour three luxury properties in Orange County, Calif.
Gordanna and Ginna are moving from overseas to the sunny shores of Venice, Calif.; will they find all that glitters with gold?
Kathy and her husband, John, are relocating from New York City to sunny California; they're looking for a house closer to their family.
Johnny and Jenny search for a luxury home; taking them through some beautiful mega mansions in Los Angeles, Calif.; they need a house with the perfect entertaining space.
House hunters Patrick and Pol are set to see three properties in Malibu, Calif.; from modern to traditional, will these homes tick the right boxes?
Sonia and Brooklyn journey to Laguna Beach, Calif., in search of a million-dollar coastal retreat with ocean views; will they uncover their beachside blissful home?
Luxury home buyers Peter and Nathalie tour three luxury properties in Venice, Calif.
Talia and Ricarda return to Westwood and Century City; they are determined to secure their ideal home amidst competitive market conditions.
Adam and Mindy explore the San Fernando Valley, seeking a family-friendly house that balances tranquility with urban amenities.
Doug and Nicole are searching for a luxury home in Los Angeles; they need a house that's closer to their clients.
Million-dollar house hunter Veletta seeks to trade in East Coast living for the warmth of Southern California; she tours three properties in Calabasas, Calif.
John is ready to trade in Bay Area living for the beach and visits three properties in Orange County, Calif.
Erika and Sonny have just moved from Chicago and are looking for the perfect Orange County luxury home for their family.
Glen and Giovanna return to Calabasas, determined to secure their ideal home in an enclave of luxury and privacy; a look at whether they will finally find their home in Calabasas.
Henri and Chris are searching for a luxury desert home; they need a house with the modern conveniences and a house to entertain in.
Mandy and Kevin are looking for their dream home by the water; Viviana is taking them through some of the most beautiful properties that Manhattan Beach has to offer.
Jim and Cheryl are looking to retire into their dream home close to their family.
Kristina and Moe embark on a journey through Encino, Calif., in search of an elegant and spacious million-dollar home.
Hollywood producer Kathleen tours luxury properties in the 90210 zip code as she looks to move to Beverly Hills, Calif.

Dr. Toni, an LA based celebrity chiropractor, searches for a luxurious home in Park City, Utah; he wants a home large enough to host parties for family and friends, but he also wants a quiet retreat to relax.

Carol is a salon owner who is looking to relocate with her husband and expand her business to Southern California; she tours three properties in Pacific Palisades where space for her grandchildren is a must.

We meet Kristi and Beth, a mother-daughter duo from Anaheim who are on the hunt for a waterfront property; they visit three unique properties in Orange County; will Kristi and Beth find the beachfront property of their dreams?
A stay-at-home enterpriser, Ziba, is looking for the perfect home for her and her husband; they tour three luxury properties around Los Angeles; they see a modern home in Luxury Bel Air.
Alysia is an attorney looking to escape the cold, wet weather of Seattle for the desert sunshine of Palm Springs; she looks at three luxury properties in La Quinta, Calif.

Lady Tsunade wins the lottery jackpot and promises to take Lee and the gang out for five-star sushi; Iruka sensei's had enough with his disobedient students, so Lee and the gang go to the Academy to put on a show.
Naruto, Lee and the others go out hunting for matsutake mushrooms, but there are none to be found after an unusually hot summer; Neji's had enough of being forced to cross-dress for Lee's skits.
Gaara's on his way back to the Leaf Village, and Team Guy scrambles to make sure he feels welcome; the girls beg Guy Sensei to train them.

Lady Tsunade sets out to teach her charges the importance of safety after many ninja keep getting injured due to carelessness; Lady Tsunade puts Lee and the gang in charge of the village's Halloween celebration.

Guy Sensei gives the gang a rare break, but will they end up being terrorized by Orochimaru's Orochi Hot Springs trap?; Orochimaru realizes his birthday, October 27th, came and went without anyone noticing.
Lee fakes being sick so that Sakura will be his nurse, only to find that his rival in love is using the same tactic; Sasuke won the last popularity contest, while Lee wasn't even on the board.
When Orochimaru's poison leaves Guy Sensei completely bald, it's up to Lee and the gang to find him the right wig; the narrator comes down with a bad cold.

When Naruto's favorite ramen stand, Ichiraku, comes up against hard financial times, Lee tries to help the restaurant; Tenten and Neji try to get their hardworking teammate to actually use his vacation time to rest.
Owing them all many thanks, Lee tries to bond with all of his comrade's Animal Summons; with so many romantic holidays occurring in winter, Hinata aims to grow a little closer to Naruto.
An encounter with the Sand siblings turns ugly when Temari insults Tenten; Orochimaru starts longing to [LIVE] a normal life after being barred from entering a family-friendly market.
When Tsunade leaves on a diplomatic mission to a neighboring village, she leaves the only shinobi who wasn't busy, in charge - Guy; Team Guy is assigned to go on patrol with Shikamaru's team.
Lee's team stumbles upon Akatsuki's hidden base; Deidara is determined to chase them away before the rest of his teammates learn about his history with the dedicated ninja.

The Hidden Leaf Village throws a big Christmas party; there are many shinobi competing for one another's affections, so the Secret Santa can turn into a survival battle; it's time for the yearly cleanup.
Lee and the gang catch the adults participating in a tournament; Neji decides to observe Naruto and determine if the orange ninja is worthy of Hinata's affections.

Trapped by Orochimaru's blizzard, Lee and the gang fight to stay warm; popping out from the First Hokage's nostril is Rock Lee, from 30 years in the future, who has come back to give his young self a helpful robot.
Shino's bugs refuse to leave his body because the weather's too cold, so Lee and his pals help him search for replacements; A maiden's battle ensues on the floor of a department store!
When the team gets assigned to infiltrate an illegal chakra-trading ring, Lee goes to Sai for advice; a nefarious scoundrel keeps leaving the village bathrooms a filthy mess.
Lee's team gets to play ogres for the annual Setsubun festival, but Orochimaru schemes to ruin the fun; Lee and his friends have to team up with Killer Bee to protect the Hidden Cloud.
When the freezing cold leaves Lady Tsunade feeling down, the village organizes a snow-sculpting contest to cheer her up.
Jiraiya trains Lee, Naruto and Konohamaru; Tsunade takes Sakura and the girls to the hot springs and chaos ensues.
Kiba enlists Hinata and the girls to find Akamaru some canine companions; Lee and his team run into Sasuke on their way back from a mission.
Captain Yamato leads Lee, Tenten and Sai on a mission to recover a stolen scroll; Orochimaru creates a virus that turns humans into "Oro-Zombies."
It's the day before White Day, and a sinister trio of villains has ruined the village supply of sweets; A prankster keeps putting the dolls back after the Doll Festival ended.
Somehow Guy is reverted into a baby and Lee uses this opportunity to prove that he's a grown-up; Lee invites Tsunade to a marriage interview and Tsunade tries everything to make it all go downhill.
The time for the final battle against Sasuke is now; Lady Tsunade assigns Lee's team with an S-Ranked mission: prepare a cherry blossom viewing party.
Deadly ninja roam the land and the mischievous Naruto Uzumaki causes trouble.
Naruto graduates from the Ninja Academy.
Naruto must team up with Sakura and Sasuke.
Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura meet with their sensei.
Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura try everything they know to get through a survival test.
Naruto and his squad start their first mission with boring and menial tasks.

After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge.

Boozy and world-weary, NYPD Detective Jack Mosley (Bruce Willis) draws a routine assignment to transport trial witness Eddie Bunker (Mos Def) to the courthouse by 10 a.m. The task quickly becomes a deadly game of cat-and-mouse when some of Jack's fellow officers arrive to kill Eddie so that he cannot testify against them. Jack sees a way to redeem his wasted life by protecting the affable Eddie from the would-be assassins.

Two families, bound by tradition, are locked in a brutal war. Asian and African American gangs are vying for control of Oakland's waterfront. But when the first casualty is the Asian warlord's son, the gang war becomes more dangerous than either side ever imagined.

Just after the end of the Gulf War, four American soldiers decide to steal a cache of Saddam Hussein's hidden gold. Led by Sergeant Major Archie Gates, three of the men are rescued by rebels, but Sergeant Troy Barlow is captured and tortured by Iraqi intelligence. The Iraqi rebels beg for the American trio to help fight against the impending arrival of Hussein's Elite Guard. The men agree to fight in return for help rescuing Troy.
A woman sues her identical twin sister for repayment of a loan.

Ed Lover (Ed Lover) and Doctor Dre (Andre Romelle Young) are hapless New York City barbers who test the patience of their boss, Nick Crawford (Jim Moody), one too many times and end up at a police academy to try out careers in law enforcement. Training under the tough-as-nails Sergeant Cooper (Denis Leary), Ed and Dre eventually learn enough skills to become rookie cops. For their first major assignment, they attempt to thwart a corrupt businessman at odds with Nick over property development.

"Pluto Nash" is an action comedy set on the moon in the year 2087, starring Eddie Murphy as the title character, an audacious nightclub owner who finds himself in hot water when he refuses to sell his club to the local mob. The lunar gangsters are helping the mysterious Rex Crater mastermind a plan to take over the moon.
When a young girl and her dying mother are joined by a black male cook who comes to live with them, little do they know that their lives are about to change forever.

Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

Jack Conrad is a death-row inmate awaiting execution in a Central American jail when a TV producer buys him and takes him to a remote island. There, Jack and nine other prisoners learn they are to fight each other to the death, with freedom as the prize for the sole survivor. The producer plans to broadcast the event live and uncensored over the Internet.
A former bounty hunter (Randy Orton) lands in a tournament where convicts fight to the death for an online audience.
Held hostage by a dangerous couple, a widower and his daughter must work together to outsmart their captors and survive the night.

A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of ruthless drug traffickers.

Tris Prior lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

Tris escapes with Four to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.
