Professor Phillip Goodman devotes his life to exposing phony psychics and fraudulent supernatural shenanigans. His skepticism soon gets put to the test when he receives news of three chilling and inexplicable cases -- disturbing visions in an abandoned asylum, a car accident deep in the woods and the spirit of an unborn child. Even scarier -- each of the macabre stories seems to have a sinister connection to the professor's own life.
A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.
A woman links her mother's increasingly volatile behavior to an evil presence at their family's decaying country home.

Northern Ireland, 1960: Father Thomas Riley and Father John Thornton are dispatched by the Vatican to investigate reports of a miracle, a statue of the Virgin Mary weeping blood, at a remote Catholic asylum for immoral women. Armed with 16mm film cameras to record their findings, the priests instead discover a depraved horror show of sadistic nuns, satanism and demonic possession. Supernatural forces are at work here, but they are not the doing of God.
Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.
A woman plagued by nightmares of a serial killer learns her dreams have a horrifying connection to the real world.
Wherever your destination, traveling local or far, indoor or outdoor, you can be sure AccuWeather Weekend always has you covered.
Goes beyond the forecast to give you the how and why about stuff you wanted to ask about weather, space and science.

Decades after the abduction of his newborn twin, world-famous American pianist John Ma (Jackie Chan) arrives in Hong Kong to perform and finds himself face-to-face with Boomer (Jackie Chan), the identical twin brother he has never known. When the reunited brothers switch places by mistake, John discovers that Boomer is a petty criminal with a knack for getting into trouble. Soon John gets in over his head with a group of gangsters looking for Boomer, and his brother vows to save him.

After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. The children hear promises of a world of opulence and California fun -- all they have to do is move into the Glasses' gated house. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.
An ex-military man strives for a secret life of crime, and his path leads to the kidnapping of a teenage heiress.

Selfish teen Alex Gardner (Dennis Quaid) is coerced into joining a government project in which psychics like him are trained to enter others' dreams. He starts learning to use his abilities to do good, but before long, a new official, Bob Blair (Christopher Plummer), seizes control of the project. A writer (George Wendt) helps Alex uncover Blair's true motives, which involve assassination via dreams. Soon, only Alex and a beautiful scientist (Kate Capshaw) stand in the way of something terrible.
A faith healer (Robert Powell) turns his supernatural powers on a hostile PR man (Broderick Crawford) while treating a senator's (David Hemmings) son.
Boozing charter pilots (Terence Hill, Bud Spencer) in the Andes help out emerald hunters on the Amazon.
After Ham De-gil enters the gambling world, he is set up as the fall guy in a crooked deal. To get revenge, he enters a final game which can be fatal to the loser.
Pre-WWII, the Japanese navy commissioned the creation of the impressive super ship Yamato, and it was strongly opposed by a top official who insisted on more strategic and battle-ready warships.
One night in Tokyo, a self-confident young boxer and a sex worker get caught up in a drug-smuggling plot involving organized crime and corrupt cops.

In poverty-stricken Kaiko City, a corrupt mayoral candidate eliminates rival mafias, prompting a released ex-cop to lead a treacherous battle for justice with a special task force in the gritty underworld.
The life story of Yip Man, the first person to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun.
Movie, Action, Martial arts, Biography, Historical drama

Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt group of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself as a kung fu master.
Movie, Action, Biography, Historical drama, Martial arts
Martial-arts master Ip Man takes on a crooked developer and his gang of brutal thugs.
A corrupt prosecutor plans for revenge against Hyun-Jung's crime organization by using her loyal partner, Sang-Hoon.

Three sworn brothers are tasked with annihilating a corrupt fugitive and his followers, but a mistake reveals the brothers are being used as pawns in a deadly game filled with secrets, conspiracies and lethal consequences.
A general was forced to kill his partner in an operation and must try to avoid being found guilty while being blackmailed by a mysterious woman. Turns out there is a bigger scheme behind all this.
Movie, Action, Historical drama, Adventure, Thriller, Mystery

Bong is a highly respected cop with a long history of success on dangerous cases. However, his past soon comes back to haunt him when his former protégé seeks revenge against all those who have wronged him.
Movie, Action, Thriller, Martial arts, Crime drama, Mystery
A lonely woman in Tokyo discovers her alter ego when she takes an English class.

Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Bozhao Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways.

For thousands of years, people have held the belief that everyday objects can possess hidden energy; talismans are seen to provide protection, good fortune, and some are thought to embody a higher power.

The towering obelisks of ancient Egypt weigh hundreds of tons; while mainstream scholars identify them as monuments to the pharaohs, ancient astronaut theorists suggest they may have served a technological purpose.

In the 21st century, UFOs have gone from fringe science to mainstream obsession; a new generation of UFO hunters employ technology, and unidentified flying objects are openly investigated by the government.

Satellite images, ground-penetrating radar and thermal scanning leads to new evidence that appears to substantiate the belief held by millions of people that Earth has been visited in the past by extraterrestrial beings.

The vast Alaskan wilderness is known for mysterious disappearances, electromagnetic anomalies, stories of strange creatures and UFO sightings; Alaska's many mysteries could be due to a presence that is not of this world.

The Mutual UFO Network is an organization devoted to the scientific investigation of unidentified aerial phenomena and other unexplained encounters; with more than five decades of investigations, MUFON's extensive database could contain proof.

Ancient mythologies tell stories of humans being abducted by otherworldly beings, even as thousands of people continue to report being taken by aliens and then returned with implants and genetic mutations.
Whether the gods of Greece including Zeus, Apollo and Poseidon from Mt. Olympus were extraterrestrial visitors to Earth.
Researchers study giant ancient drawings found etched into the desert floor, which may be a part of an ancient alien code.
Charlie dates Jennifer's business partner and finds out she has sexual anger issues; the support group tries to find a rich boyfriend for Lacey.
Lindsay Lohan comes to Charlie for therapy, and they begin a tumultuous relationship that ends up getting her in trouble.
Charlie's neighbors find out he's been having clients with anger issues meeting at his house; Kate goes with Jennifer to help find a dress for Sam.
When Sam finds out that her favorite horse is in equine therapy, Charlie uses that as a bonding exercise for his group.
Charlie inadvertently puts two patients together in a romantic relationship.
Charlie manages to persuade Kate to take Nolan on as her PA, but Nolan discovers more than Charlie would like to know. Meanwhile, Lacey is having problems in prison.
Charlie lets his father help him coach a high school baseball team; Kate takes over Charlie's group during his coaching gig.
Charlie's ex causes him problems with his group when she becomes one of his patient's life coach; Lacey helps Charlie's dad get a Facebook account.
Martin tells Kate that Charlie and Jennifer are getting back together; Nolan helps Ed as his anger buddy.
Charlie shakes up his relationship with Kate while dealing with the return of Jen's ex-boyfriend; Charlie's group volunteers at a soup kitchen.
Charlie and Kate try to control their sexual urges as they begin work together on their sex study; Lacey starts a new job as a pharmaceutical rep.
After his breakup, Charlie starts a friends-with-benefits relationship with a hot woman subject from the sex study.
Charlie's trip to Lake Tahoe with the group is interrupted when he gets some interesting news from Kate.
Charlie begins seeing a new female therapist who has unorthodox therapy methods; Patrick tricks Ed into thinking he won the lottery.
Charlie steals a hot woman from an angry nerd who finds a way to make his life a living hell; Lacey takes drugs.
Charlie learns a secret about Jen's new boyfriend when he joins his therapy group; Ed moves in with Patrick.
Charlie begins dating a woman, not knowing that her brother is a serial killer from his prison support group.
Charlie suspects Jen's boyfriend is cheating on her with his patient; Ed and Patrick help Nolan after his apartment gets robbed.
Charlie has to deal with the aftermath when his dad moves in with his patient, and they hit someone with their car; Lacey takes Nolan out for a night of clubbing.
Charlie mistakenly becomes a sex surrogate for one of Kate's patients; Jennifer gets upset when Sam gets a tattoo.
Charlie gets jealous of Jennifer's much younger boyfriend; Patrick helps Lacey look sexy for her first modeling gig.
A riot begins at prison and Charlie is held hostage by his group. Lacey, Nolan and Ed throw Patrick a surprise birthday party, but he has to hide the news of the riot from Sam.
Charlie gets Sean fired from the strip club when he sleeps with a stripper.
Nick discovers Suzanne's wedding ring is not actually real and sets out to have a real ring made before she learns the truth, while Suzanne thinks she has lost her wedding ring forever.
Kevin's new career as a child actor quickly hits the skids when his big break causes him to get an even bigger head.
Nick is disappointed when Frank crashes his Father's Day trip. However, when a lift stops, the men are forced to have a meaningful heart-to-heart.
Suzanne catches Nick watching a rap video with a pole dancer in it and decides to show Nick that she is the best pole dancer on the block.
When Kevin enters a campaign for class president, Suzanne wants him to run a clean campaign but Terrence, the Karl Rove of school elections, is adamant that he must go negative.
Nick needs a new van for work, but Suzanne worries they are already too much in debt and cannot afford to buy a new one. It turns out Suzanne has some credit issues she has not revealed to Nick.
Mr Peterson asks Nick to co-host his wife's charity walkathon, but Nick is soon put into an uncomfortable situation when he suspects that Mrs Peterson has stolen Marilyn's bracelet.
When Suzanne's ex-husband wants to lower his monthly child support payments, Nick jumps at the chance while Suzanne has mixed feelings about Frank abandoning his own responsibilities.
Mr Peterson announces a new KAWT morning show featuring a reality show star as the co-host, but she threatens Nick and the other anchors' jobs in order to steal the spotlight.
Nick helps Kevin with his Valentine's Day at school, but it goes wrong when Kevin gets sent home.
Nick and Suzanne try to attend a highly anticipated movie premiere, but when their busy schedules get in the way, both are tempted to secretly go to the movie without the other.
Suzanne and Nick go on a People's Court-type TV show when Nick lies about having spent a gift card Suzanne gave him, which she finds and spends on herself, calling him on his lie.
When Nick is invited to play in a celebrity golf tournament at Walt Disney World, Suzanne is disappointed she has to miss the family's first holiday.
Nick goes crazy buying items in bulk at The Big Box Club discount super store that the family does not need. Meanwhile, Lindsey enters a speed-texting contest.
When Lindsey decides to adopt a vegan lifestyle, Suzanne convinces Nick they should go vegan as well - a decision they soon regret when they learn the extent of Lindsey's dedication.
Suzanne suspects Nick has a kid from a past relationship when she meets Kevin's new friend Nathan. He does everything Nick likes, eats and wears, and his mother is an old fling of Nick's.
When Nick points out that Suzanne has issues letting go of controlling everything, Suzanne lets everything go. The family realises they need Suzanne's ways to run a successful household.
Despite warnings from other co-workers, Nick gets stuck hosting a charity telethon, while Suzanne has to deal with a rich client's boring wedding plans.
When Marilyn brings a dangerous flu back from a trip to Mexico, the family must stay inside their house under quarantine.
After Nick gets pocket-dialled by Suzanne and overhears her telling Gigi something personal, he gets back at Suzanne by fake pocket-dialling her.
When Nick lands on a porn website due to a spelling error, a co-worker takes it the wrong way, forcing KAWT employees to undergo sensitivity training.
Nick angers Suzanne when he invites Martin to an exclusive sporting event before inviting his wife.
While speaking before Kevin's class for Career Day, Nick confuses the students by implying that building connections is more important than studying hard and getting good grades.
Suzanne meets a relationship expert and becomes convinced that she and Nick are having compatibility issues.
Nick tricks Suzanne and Marilyn into spending a weekend together at a spa, where it becomes clear it will take more than a masseuse to relieve the tension in the women's relationship.
Nick and Suzanne stop talking to each other after Suzanne gets upset with Nick for his attempts to fix her problems without listening to her.
After balking at the high price of a purse Suzanne loves, Nick thinks again and tries to buy it as a gift - but Suzanne has already secretly bought the last purse for herself.
Nick attempts to have a night out with Lindsey, but when all she wants to do is to follow around a young celebrity DJ, Nick tries to teach her how a man should really treat her the way she deserves.
Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.
Lindsey has a new crush and Gigi has a new boyfriend, but when certain secrets cannot be kept, a web of misinformation nearly ruins both situations.
When Nick's new field producer, Sam, turns out to be female, Suzanne is convinced she is trying to steal her man, a suggestion Nick thinks is absurd until Sam actually makes a move on him.
Nick and Suzanne go head-to-head in the kitchen when Nick says cooking is easy and Suzanne challenges him to a family cooking competition.
Kevin helps Frankie study for a test, but Frankie bribes him to take the test for him.
Lindsey is thrilled to get her first job at Up and Down Burger, but when she gives out free food to failed NBA hopeful Terrell, she soon learns the consequences of stealing at the workplace.
Lindsey auditions to dance in a P-Nut music video, but considers quitting when she discovers that the choreographer is a drill sergeant and the other dancers are far more experienced.
When Lindsey accompanies Suzanne to work and meets an old friend of her mother's, a misunderstanding causes Lindsey to believe she may have an older brother that she never knew about.
When Suzanne is overly protective teaching Lindsey how to drive, Nick takes over and makes Lindsey feel confident, until she scratches Suzanne's car and chooses to lie about the incident.
When Troy provokes a school bully, Kevin strikes up a friendship with his tormentor to avoid a beat down. However, Kevin is soon faced with a difficult decision.
After a concussion, Nick is advised to not go to bed for a few hours. To avoid all risks, he attempts to stay up all night.
Suzanne is upset when Marilyn gives her an ugly bracelet as a present, but things get even uglier when Nick sees it and realizes he bought it for Marilyn and that she's re-gifted.
When a well-respected actor shadows Nick to prepare for an upcoming role as an anchor, but his methods turn out to be much more invasive that Nick had expected.
Nick refuses to give Lindsey money for a concert, so Lindsey resorts to stealing sixty dollars from Gigi's purse - but when Gigi discovers the missing money, she blames Kevin for the theft.
When the family's morning routine devolves into fighting, Gigi suggests that they try an old sorority exercise called the Lemon Squeeze in order to turn their problems around.
Nick agrees to go to a Public Enemy concert on the same night as his proposal-versary with Suzanne, who is none too pleased. The children star in internet videos wearing superhero costumes.
Nick's identity is stolen; Suzanne takes a week off to attend a wedding; Marilyn shares a life lesson.
Suzanne tries to keep Nick's birthday gift a surprise by taking out a loan from Marilyn.
Nick and Suzanne have been married for about six months, and the new blended family is beginning to experience growing pains. Nick thinks the kids do not love him and will not accept him.
The entire family plays pranks on one another. However, when the family ignores Nick's choking because they think it is another prank, Nick has a near-death experience and embraces his Zen side.
When the house sitters next door begin acting irresponsibly, Nick and Suzanne question if they are being played for fools.
The family decides to go green, but it is much harder than they thought, and they sometimes realise you have to choose between saving the planet and saving your family.
Nick's boxing match party unexpectedly takes over the family room on the same night Suzanne's book group is meeting in the living room.
Nick tries to be spontaneous, but Suzanne resists and instead plans a date night that fails. They attempt to be spontaneous together until she realises it is best not to share her plans.
Nick says he is too tired for marital relations one night, leading Suzanne to speculate and have major concerns that something is not right in their relationship.
Nick asks Suzanne to help pro baseball player Ray Savage plan a children's charity event.
Suzanne wants to have a formal portrait of the family taken, but trying to pull everyone together proves to be impossible.

Nick notices the family is disconnected and proposes a get-together with friends and family so they have the opportunity to reconnect. Unfortunately, Nick's planning leaves out some important details, leading to chaos.
Suzanne is tired of being the bad cop and Nick being the good cop with the kids, so they decide to switch places.
Kevin takes care of a rat that ends up getting lost in the house. Tension arises between Gigi and Lindsey when one of Gigi's old boyfriends showers them with gifts and clothes.
When Nick happens upon an old college pal, the unexpected meeting gives rise to a business plan that involves a sports star and an energy drink. The results, however, are not so bubbly.
Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, her friend Danielle and husband Steve. However, the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.
Just being rich isn't enough to endure the teen oppression at Shinhwa -- loners are often marked as targets by the bored über-clique called F4.
A wicked rumor is spread on the Internet that a second-year student at Shinhwa High School is pregnant.
Not too eager to watch Jan Di dancing with one of his best friends, Jun Pyo exits the ballroom and ends up taking out his frustrations by the poolside.
Making a rash choice, Jan Di tells her mother she has to go somewhere and runs off, heading toward Namsan Tower.
Jan Di's bike is set ablaze while she is attacked with water balloons and blasted with a fire extinguisher.
A psychic foresees that Jan Di will be losing something significant.
Jun Pyo intends to expel his best friend and Jan Di out of Shinhwa High School -- and out of F4.
Jan Di dashes to the hospital after being informed that Jun Pyo had been in an accident.
Yi-jung gets a frantic call from his mother threatening to commit suicide because of his father.
Yoh agrees to teach Haruna how to get a boyfriend but on the condition she doesn't fall in love with him.
Yi Jung's mother frantically calls him threatening to commit suicide.
A note indicates that class has been moved to the science lab. The lab is unoccupied, but Jan Di waits, not realizing that the room is filling with fumes.
Jan Di's father gets kidnapped by loan sharks, which inevitably forces Jan Di's mother to swallow her pride and plead for Madam Kang's help.
The F4 guys have moved on to college while Jan Di has entered her senior year of high school. She has not heard from Jun Pyo since he left.
Jan Di waits to hear the conclusions of F3's meeting with Jun-pyo, and can tell from their look that it was not good.
After treating Jan Di in a cruel manner, Mr. Jung prepares everything so that Jun-Pyo can visit her in Seoul. Will he be able to go without Madam Kang finding out?
Jan Di's family hears about Jun-pyo's engagement and asks her miserably if it's true.
Ji-hoo can see how hurt Jan Di is by the kiss, and continues to follow her as she stumbles around in shock.
Jun-pyo begins seeing Jae-Kyung in a new light, like he's seeing her for the first time as a potential friend -- or maybe a kindred spirit.

Former sportswriter Andy Farmer and his secretly aspiring author wife, Elizabeth, move to a small farm in Vermont, so Andy can focus on writing a novel. They quickly realize that the locals are not as welcoming as they'd like and that the farm is more distracting than inspiring. Having trouble with his manuscript, and with his marriage on the rocks, Andy is forced to take hilariously drastic measures in an attempt to get his life back on track.

Jack (Billy Crystal) is a straitlaced lawyer with a loving wife (Julia Louis-Dreyfus). Dale (Robin Williams) is suicidal about his stalled career as an artist. The only thing they have in common is Colette (Nastassja Kinski), with whom they both had an affair years ago. Unbeknownst to the two men, she had a son, Scott (Charlie Hofheimer), who is now missing. After she tells Jack and Dale that one of them could be the father, the pair set out to find Scott and prove who the real father is.
A smooth-talking singer convinces a young woman (LeToya Luckett) to leave the security of her family, friends and church to join a traveling gospel show.

Teenager Reagan Wills dreams of playing soccer like Alex Morgan, her hero. A poster of the soccer star magically comes to life in Reagan's bedroom, and Alex helps Reagan learn the value of determination.
Bo (Jonathan Bennett), Luke (Randy Wayne) and Daisy Duke try to prevent Boss Hogg from seizing Uncle Jesse's (Willie Nelson) farm.

When a respected New York homicide detective (Robert De Niro) discovers the prime suspect in a murder case is his estranged son (James Franco), he is forced to return home to the decaying boardwalks of Long Beach, Long Island to confront the darkness of his past. During the course of the investigation, he realizes that his failures as a father - and his unresolved anguish about the painful estrangement - have deeply influenced his son's life.

Conceived as a marrow donor for her gravely ill sister, Anna Fitzgerald (Abigail Breslin) has undergone countless surgeries and medical procedures in her short life. Though their older daughter's life has no doubt been prolonged, the unorthodox decision of Anna's parents has cracked the entire family's foundation. When Anna sues her parents for emancipation, it sets off a court case that threatens to destroy the family for good.

Writer Alex Sheldon must finish his novel within a month. If he doesn't, he won't get paid. And, if that happens, angry Mafia types to whom he owes money will come looking for him. In order to expedite things, Alex hires typist Emma Dinsmore and begins dictating his novel. The book is about a doomed love affair between a character similar to Alex and a character named Polina Delacroix. But, as Alex falls for Emma, his work takes a different turn.

In their quest for free beer, bumbling Canadian brothers Bob (Rick Moranis) and Doug McKenzie (Dave Thomas) wind up working at the Elsinore Brewery. The hapless lads uncover a sinister mind-control plot spearheaded by Brewmeister Smith (Max von Sydow) and must stop the scheme, which also involves Uncle Claude (Paul Dooley), a member of the Elsinore family. As Bob and Doug try to prevent Smith from taking over the world, they also manage to drink plenty of their favorite sudsy beverage.

After the murder of their young son, the marriage between Macon (William Hurt) and his wife Sarah (Kathleen Turner) disintegrates, and she moves out. After a freak accident puts him on crutches, Macon goes to stay with his quirky siblings at the family home, where he meets the spirited Muriel (Geena Davis), a dog trainer with a young son of her own, with whom he begins a friendship. When Sarah learns about this, she attempts a reconciliation and Macon is forced to make a decision.
A Washington waitress saves the Emir of Ohtar's life, launching her diplomatic career and a scandal.

College student Wyatt (Paul Rudd) is convinced that his hometown girlfriend, Kimberly (Christine Taylor), is cheating on him. Disconsolate at a strip club, he nonetheless tries to defend the honor of Ivy (Reese Witherspoon), one of the dancers, who befriends him for his gesture. Ivy convinces Wyatt that he should send Kimberly a vicious breakup letter, which he does, by express mail. When he has second thoughts, he and Ivy hit the road to retrieve the note before it reaches its destination.

While attempting to seduce gorgeous lawyer Diane Lightson (Demi Moore), wealthy gadabout Chris Thorne (Chevy Chase) agrees to drive her to Atlantic City, N.J. But, when some reckless driving draws the attention of a deeply critical cop (John Candy), they and the flamboyant "Brazillionaires" (Taylor Negron, Bertila Damas) who tagged along end up in the court of a grotesque and vengeful judge (Dan Aykroyd), who has a special vendetta against the wealthy and erudite.

Two explorers are racing Lewis and Clark to the Pacific Ocean in 1804. Edwards (Matthew Perry) is a glory-seeking fop who's out of his league, Hunt (Chris Farley) is a slovenly, clumsy tracker with a soft spot for toilet humor. Along with a team of misfits and losers, the duo wreaks havoc on the American frontier.

Roy (Nicolas Cage), a depressed con artist with obsessive-compulsive disorder, and Frank (Sam Rockwell), his partner, find their line of work complicated by the arrival of Roy's teenage daughter, Angela (Alison Lohman). Angela brings some spirit back into Roy's life, and some of his disorder symptoms seem to disappear. But when Angela wants to learn the family business, and Roy allows her to assist on a big scam concerning a businessmen (Bruce McGill), he reconsiders his parenting techniques.
Movie, Dark comedy, Crime drama, Thriller
Un héroe discapacitado de la guerra de Vietnam toma medidas drásticas para conseguir dinero para un trabajo dental.
La adicción a la cocaína de un presentador de TV incita a su preocupado hijo para entregarlo a la policía.
Los padres (Anne Jackson, Eli Wallach) de un niño en estado de coma tratan de consolar a su hija, que se siente responsable.
Un joven imprudente y una adolescente embarazada y soltera aprenden una lección sobre el amor y la responsabilidad.
Una escritora se encuentra con el tema de sus novelas de la vida real, un espía asesinado en 1968.
Negocios sucios de un empresario consiguen "matarlo", pero Jonathan y Mark arreglan una segunda oportunidad en la vida para él.
Un perro callejero se convierte en el vínculo entre un huérfano y una pareja casada que no pueden tener hijos.
Después de experimentar un golpe devastador en sus planes de tener una familia, Paul y Michele se dan cuenta de que el niño que quieren ya está en sus vidas.
Un boxeador joven pone su carrera en la línea y descubre la desagradable verdad sobre su hermano y representante.
Jonathan y Mark ayudan a una familia afroamericana a integrarse en un barrio exclusivo y a combatir el racismo existente.
Jonathan, vestido como un hombre lobo, viene al rescate cuando adolescentes borrachos acosan a un joven.
Un artista de vodevil recibe una segunda oportunidad para alcanzar el éxito y reconciliarse con su hijo egoísta.
Jonathan ayuda a un niño a escaparse a un mundo de fantasía después de la trágica muerte de su padre.
Un consejero en un campamento para ciegos recluta a Jonathan para evitar el suicidio de un hombre que pierde la vista.
Jonathan y Mark chocan con un guardián sobre las reformas que uniría las mujeres reclusas con sus hijos.
Un ranchero intenta prevenir el asesinato de caballos.
Jonathan y Mark se hacen pasar por consejeros de drogas en una escuela secundaria, donde un estudiante murió de una sobredosis.
Santa Claus va a juicio por protestar contra unos grandes almacenes que promocionan armas de juguete en Navidad.
Jonathan (Michael Landon) intenta persuadir a una maestra soltera (Doreen Lang) de adoptar a cuatro hermanos huérfanos.
La dedicación de un médico rural (Roscoe Lee Browne) a las necesidades médicas de su comunidad casi lo arruina física y financieramente. Con Renee Jones.
Un infatigable fiscal de distrito intenta conseguir una condena por delito grave contra un vagabundo acusado de robar una botella de vino.
La amistad de Mark con un antiguo compañero de policía se ve amenazada cuando el agente le pide que mienta sobre un crimen racista.
Jonathan tiene que lidiar con la ira y la frustración de perder sus poderes sobrenaturales después de que él rechaza una misión de Dios.
Jonathan ahora mortal, tiene problemas para encontrar un trabajo, y Jennifer no comparte su deseo de una relación a largo plazo.
Jonathan da un periodista famoso, que está encarcelado en América del Sur, la oportunidad de entrar en el sueño de su esposa.
Jonathan y Mark ayudan a una antigua bailarina a superar su amargura por ser discapacitada.

Esta serie dramática representa en cada capítulo de una hora historias distintas y reales sobre mujeres mexicanas que atraviesan diferentes vicisitudes. Las experiencias de estas mujeres tratan de temas censurados por la sociedad y por lo tanto ellas los enfrentan en silencio, algunas de las situaciones que se examinan son: el abuso infantil, el embarazo no deseado, asesinatos, la pornografía y la violencia familiar entre otras. Al final de cada episodio se muestra una lista de centros o agencias de ayuda para personas que se sientan identificadas con los casos específicos, se hace un llamado para que busquen ayuda y rompan su silencio.
Un espacio en el que se tocan temas controversiales, de forma abierta y sin censura como sexo, infidelidad, identidad de género, salud mental, conductas delictivas, o fractura familiar.

La serie cuenta, en cada capítulo, una historia diferente con personajes nuevos. El eje central de las historias es el transporte público, ya que todas ellas suceden dentro de alguno de los medios de traslado del país.

La serie de misterio y espanto, relata leyendas populares escalofriantes que aterrorizan hasta los más valientes. El programa cuenta estas historias y trata en lo posible de grabar en las localidades, algunas de estas son lugares históricos en que supuestamente las leyendas sucedieron o visita lugares parecidos para así tratar de reflejar la historia original y hacerla tan parecida como sea posible. Si quiere dormir con la luz prendida observe este programa que lo mantendrá en suspenso y aterrorizado.
Un hombre se enamora de una rica heredera y la ayuda a pelear contra su tío que quiere quedarse con su fortuna.
Un programa que aborda la información más relevante del fin de semana.
Un programa de entretenimiento que aborda temas de interés personal como cocina, belleza, sexualidad, reflexiones, consejos y otros.

La hija de Santa realiza su primer viaje lejos del Polo Norte durante la temporada navideña con la esperanza de encontrar aventuras y amor en la soleada California.

La investigadora de seguros Lana Lawton regresa a casa para Navidad y se entera de una serie de robos dirigidos contra propietarios de tiendas. Lana intenta resolver el caso, pero debe convencer al jefe de policía para que la deje ayudar.

Un soldado sirviendo en Afganistán se convierte en la figura paterna de un niño que le escribe cartas desde California. Cuando el soldado regresa de la batalla, un romance empieza a formarse entre él y la mamá divorciada del niño.
Una exitosa abogada emprende una búsqueda por su alma gemela; le han dicho que su destino está ligado a un hombre llamado Michael.
Una jinete lucha para poder caminar nuevamente cuando un terrible accidente a caballo la deja paralizada.

Bob, un detective que acaba de enviudar, abandona Los Ángeles para instalarse, junto a su hija, en el rancho de su familia en Montana. Al poco de llegar, Bob acepta el cargo de nuevo sheriff del pueblo.
Un accidente provoca que un empleado (Eddie Cibrian) de limpieza tenga la habilidad de sanar a otras personas, pero arriesgando su propia vida.
Obligada a aceptar un trabajo después de perder su fortuna, una mujer aprende valiosas lecciones mientras desarrolla una relación con su nuevo jefe y su hijo pequeño.
En Las Vegas por su fiesta de soltera, una novia (Kellie Martin) despierta casada a un hombre distinto (Ethan Erickson) un famoso actor en vez de su prometido (Bradley Snedeker).
Insuficientes fondos obligan a una pareja de recién casados a tomar difíciles decisiones.
Ellie y Martín son dos recién casados que han perdido sus respectivos trabajos y tienen que irse a vivir a casa de los padres de ella.
Un soldado del ejército de los Estados Unidos en licencia, ayuda a su esposa a operar una panadería.
Un exmarido y un primer amor provocan que una mujer dude acerca de su próxima boda.
Un abogado citadino (Jeremy London) enfrenta al jurado más difícil cuando acompaña a su campirana novia (Dorie Barton) a casa de sus padres en Navidad.

En un bosque, emerge, desnudo y bañado en sangre, Elías, sin un solo recuerdo de lo que le ha ocurrido a él y a sus tres amigos desaparecidos. Su hermano, un agente de policía local, es el único que puede ayudarlo a resolver el enigma y exculparlo.
Una joven mujer que atraviesa una crisis económica, una niña y un perro fiel pasan la noche en una casa a punto de derrumbarse, que además que esconde un tesoro y un espíritu atormentado.
Un grupo de buzos (Silke, Unax Ugalde, Andrés Gertrúdix) se encuentran a la deriva en el océano y abordan un barco de tripulación asesina.
Mientras la investigación de un profesor universitario sobre sucesos sobrenaturales se ve rechazada, Ibrahim busca desesperadamente una cura para la enfermedad de su esposa.
Jennifer encuentra una escena brutal en su casa y descubre marcas demoníacas por todas partes. La salud de Zeina mejora, pero Ibrahim comienza a perder el control.
Mercedes está obsesionada con subir al altillo de su casa. Ese lugar esconde un misterio. En otro lugar cuatro amigos reciben un llamado de Adrián, un amigo que no ven hace tiempo.
Un especialista en genética es enviado a alojarse en una posada costera para encontrar el origen de una infección que ha comenzado a propagarse lentamente.
Tres estudiantes universitarios investigan eventos paranormales.

Un grupo de estudiantes de cine trata de hacer un documental sobre vídeos virales en internet, sin imaginar que tendrán que encarar una venganza paranormal que se esconde en lo más profundo de la web, un adversario inclemente y sediento de sangre que no parará hasta acabar con ellos.

Restos humanos aparecen en un torrente de Sant Miquel de Balansat, un pequeño pueblo rural al norte de Ibiza. El sargento Prats, jefe de la Guardia Civil, y el cabo Ramírez, su nuevo ayudante, acuden al sitio a investigar. Prats no se muestra sorprendido por el hallazgo, pues le revela a Ramírez que el descubrimiento de restos humanos se repite año tras año desde hace dos décadas.

Fico Fellove (Andy Garcia), an apolitical Havana club owner, gets caught in the middle when Fidel Castro's Communist Revolution sweeps through Cuba. He tries to keep the strife outside the walls of his popular establishment, but his family becomes divided when his brothers (Nestor Carbonell, Enrique Murciano) join the fight against Batista.

Seeking new inspiration and a fresh start, married musicians Darcy and Daphne move to the Welsh countryside to finish their new record. While collecting audio samples, Darcy inadvertently creates a field recording of a mysterious sound never before heard by human ears. The discovery soon renews Daphne's creative energy, but as the echoes of her music bleed into the surrounding landscape, ancient and malevolent woodland forces are disturbed.
A Norwegian geologist (Kristoffer Joner) and his family (Ane Dahl Torp, Jonas Hoff Oftebro) fight for survival when a massive landslide causes a 250-foot tidal wave.

A young woman is transported to another world where a never-ending war is raging. There, a clutch of women lure men to their deaths at sea via radio transmissions, like 20th-century sirens. She soon realizes she's not the killer they want her to be.
A young man and his younger siblings who have concealed the death of their mother to remain together are plagued by a sinister presence in their home.

After his troops ditch him for a slumber party at the posh home of his rival brother (Johnny Knoxville), a scoutmaster (Patton Oswalt) lures the youths away in the middle of the night for an ill-advised camping trip.
Personal trainers (Guy Pearce, Cobie Smulders) are charged with whipping a newly wealthy and highly unmotivated slob (Kevin Corrigan) into shape.
A honeymooning bride (Rose Leslie) goes sleepwalking into the woods surrounding a secluded cabin. When she returns she looks the same, but something about her is frighteningly different.
A plant created via genetic engineering appears to produce curious changes in the people and animals it comes into contact with.
The malware worm Stuxnet, famously used against Iranian centrifuges, has been claimed by many to have originated as a joint effort between America and Israel.
A teenager (Shailene Woodley) relishes her newfound freedom after her disturbed mother (Eva Green) vanishes, but the strange facts of the disappearance soon begin to haunt her.

Katja's life falls apart in the blink of an eye when two neo-Nazis kill her husband and 6-year-old son in a bomb attack. Her quest for justice soon pushes her to the edge as the two suspects stand trial for murder.

Arrested after a failed bombing attempt, a single mother and IRA member (Andrea Riseborough) falls into the hands of a British agent (Clive Owen) who offers her a choice: Spy on her IRA comrades, or spend a long prison term away from her young son.

New Zealander Burt Munro spent years perfecting his classic Indian motorcycle. The year is 1967, and Burt takes his machine to Utah's salt flats, where he attempts the impossible, using his dream bike to set a new world's record for speed. Based on a true story, the record Munro set more than three decades ago still has not been broken to this day.

When a British TV show becomes popular, an American network often makes its own version of the show. In this case, Lifetime is importing this series that pits four amateur cooks against one another as they compete for a cash prize. Each contestant prepares a meal for a dinner party -- with a unique theme, location and menu -- for the other competitors, who critique and score the cook. The contestant who earns the most points for his or her party wins the title of the host with the most and, more importantly, the money. Radio personality Todd Pettengill narrates the series.
The queen of cooking, Lianne, is up against Lee's Rat Pack-themed evening.
The differences between two contestants lead to some entertaining exchanges around the table.
Friendships are made; secrets are revealed; outrageous outfits are de rigueur.

On the Isle of Man, the first host is 43-year-old riding school owner Michelle; she is hoping to impress by serving up a country-themed menu of garden shot game pie for the main course and homegrown rhubarb on sponges for dessert.
On the Isle of Man, it's retired gardener Eva's turn to host; she's been the centre of attention, and she plans to go all out to win.
Justine is hoping to woo her guests with a love-themed evening; everything seems to be going to plan when Stuart decides to get on one knee and propose.
Bike enthusiast Richard is hoping to race into pole position with a night based on the famous Isle of Man TT motorbike race.
Stuart's love of American food shows in his menu, with an American mezze to start, steak and chips for main and a Harvard mess for dessert.

DJ Dom kicks off the week, serving up a menu inspired by the 90s Madchester music scene; hosting his first ever dinner party, Dom is a disaster in the kitchen and has to call on a celebrity pal to bail him out.
Sasha is hoping to wow the guests and throws a Chinese-Pakistani fusion meal with plastic cutlery and plates.
Katherine's goes for an easy menu but hopes her simple meal of smoked salmon with a horseradish cream, chorizo and chickpea will still impress.
It's the fourth day of the competition in Manchester and the turn of redcoat turned barber Danny to host; Danny throws an evening of Bulgarian cuisine in homage to his wife.
Glamour goth Maria, after a hit-and-miss week, is hoping to wow her guests with a traditional Asian meal with a twist.
Three couples from Essex compete to see who can throw the best dinner party; the couples are Amie, Mark, Gemma, Nathan, Simon and Suzanne.
Features Sheffield's dining competitors Helen, Claire, Ben, Greg and Rosie.
Five strangers from Belfast, namely Steve, Julie, Justin, Cushla and Marty, compete to throw the best dinner party.
Four strangers from Greater Manchester compete to host the best dinner party; Sukie dishes up a menu from her native South Korea.
Featuring a Caribbean feast, a vegetable banquet and a dark horse.
In Nottingham, Derby and Leicester, Dylan offers a home from home experience, Sam treats her guests to fine dining, crystal healer Angela goes booze-free and Mod Aaron ends with a bang.
Four culinary hopefuls from Pretoria aim to host the best dinner party and win the cash prize; the hosts include Alexander Georghiades, Nomvula Mthethwa, Wessel Vosser, and Marleen Van Rooyen.
Four culinary hopefuls from aim to host the best dinner party to win the cash prize; the hosts include an artist, a plumber and activist, a witch and a business relations manager.
Four culinary hopefuls in Cape Town aim to host the best dinner party and win the cash prize; the hosts include mentalist Jeremy Dyer, a sultry tango diva and a madcap accountant.
Four culinary hopefuls aim to host the best dinner party and win the cash prize.
Dining tonight a pole dancer, an amateur actor and a chatterbox.
Four culinary hopefuls from Johannesburg aim to host the best dinner party and win the cash prize; the hosts include a Stephen Fry lookalike, a feisty PA and a flamboyant fashionista.
Amateur chefs compete to host the ultimate dinner party, with shocking guests and delicious entertainment.
Businessman Sani attempts to impress his dinner guests, Jane, Sharon and Stephen, with an African-inspired cuisine.
Will it be a fairy tale ending for Diane, or will Kay show them how it's done?

The toxicity in Rebecca and Jake's relationship might be too much to overcome; Tia says a drunken fistfight ended her friendship with Dionne four years ago, and she hopes that Karamo can help restore it.

Lashoun got daughter Jelisha involved in a lingerie basketball league, but this isn't the path Jelisha wants to pursue; Roselee has been cashing in on her fame on social media but says Jeremiah is having a hard time accepting she's the breadwinner.
John and Shay share their struggles of having a blended family; Barbara does the best she can in raising her 16-year-old niece, Ayonna, who is making bad choices.

Victoria believes Queecha and Vincent are her long-lost brother and sister, but the two aren't convinced that Victoria is part of their family; Candi lost her salon to a fire and blames her former friend, Patsy, for the blaze.

Brianna's boyfriend, Taylor, cheats on her, but she wants to try to make things work for the sake of their children; Reanna wants to salvage her marriage, but Everett isn't certain he wants to stay married to her.
Zakirah is tired of boyfriend J'Quan's cheating accusations; pregnant Sharma wants to address the abuse she endured from her mother, Stephanie.

After a night of too much drinking, Ro Ro says that some of her money went missing, and she suspects her cousin and a former friend; John wants to know if he is the biological dad of daughter Caitlin, whose birth certificate says "father unknown."

Anissa says a man named Nate rescued her from an untenable situation, and she believes he is her biological father; Infinity says her mother was emotionally and physically abusive toward her, while her mom says they used to be best friends.
At first, Neshay thought Michael was her cousin, but it turns out that he may be her father: Karamo tries to end a 29-year-old riddle; Kyla and Josh return with a wonderful update.

Renee says fiancé Picard ignores her phone calls, blocks her on social media and vanishes for days at a time; Jordan, who endured very tough circumstances while growing up, fears that Elizabeth has been lying and cheating on him.

Ollie says he confessed to his wife, Angel, about cheating on her and now wants to unlock her phone, saying that she communicated with her exes; Ernaysia says her ex, Marcus, has a tendency to use words that trigger her; David proposes to Jennifer.

Sheilyn watched Aledia get tossed out of a club and continued partying, so the former best friends haven't spoken since; Angel is dating a man nearly 20 years younger than herself and has reservations about his generosity with his friends.
Latoya wants to know if Tony is her biological father; Cole and his mom return to the show with an update on what life has been like since going to rehab for his addiction.
A woman spends the better part of two decades trying to solve a DNA mystery; a woman thinks she may be running out of patience with her boyfriend's infidelity and toxic behavior.
Jalen and Olivia have been together since college; now Jalen believes Olivia is cheating; Theara wants to know why Eric goes away in the middle of the night for hours.
Quandra says that her sister Deidra's fiancé, Jamar, is a cheating and manipulative liar; Andrea believes that her daughter Ruby has crossed over to the dark side and is a devil worshiper.
Eric says his 14-year-old sister is out of control and headed down the path of self-destruction; Lesley is convinced that his wife is cheating on him.

Shawntia has more than $13,000 worth of debt because of her husband Ian's gambling obsession; Mercedes is pregnant and all alone after kicking her husband, Haywood, out of the house because, during an argument, she says, he bit her.
Dytazia wants to know if her mother tried to sell her for drugs; a young boy dies while in the care of a relative; Kristie wants to know who her biological father is.

Marshall and his wife find out if he has a daughter; Keonie is fed up with being fat-shamed and controlled by his verbally abusive grandmother, who says that she's always had his back and did everything she could to raise him.
Aaliyah had to put Daijon on probation when she found out that he was cheating with strippers; Jael is ready to confront her mother after years of physical and emotional abuse.

Sisters Jazmine, Jenny and Janey hope they can repair the scar tissue from some very deep wounds; Rani is livid and can't seem to get the image of her boyfriend, Chris, with another woman out of her mind.

Brandon believes that wife Tiffany is cheating on him with several men; Mark raised Markeya and her siblings as if they were his own, but after their grandmother passed away, he noticed a change for the worse in their behavior toward him.

Best friends planned to move in together, then Fredo inexplicably ghosted Cassie and deleted her from social media; alcoholic Kelly has been sober for years and wants to repair things with her son, but he resents her for choosing the bottle over him.

Anita's daughters believe that she was responsible for their father's death; Ginai admits that she hangs out around best friend Kiki's dad, but says she would never cross the line of sleeping with him.

Derisha confronts her son's father, who refuses to spend time with him and wants a DNA test; Chris is desperate to mend fences with his teen daughter who is struggling with her transition and the breakup of her parents.

Sylvia fears that her boyfriend may be cheating with their provocatively dressed housemate, Santa; while Adrianne admits to abandoning daughter Deekah in the past, she says gone above and beyond to repair things with her and wants to see her again.

Newly arrived time travelers threaten to destroy Kiera and her alliance with Brad.

Kiera and Brad's trust reaches a breaking point; Carlos and Kellogg come to their own realizations; Alec has a strange encounter.

Kiera and Carlos's reunion is a bumpy one as they attempt to thwart Liber8's brazen hijacking of a prison transfer; Kellog approaches Alec with a partnership proposition.

Vicki chauffeurs comedian Bill Bailey around town in a very unusual Mercedes, Tom Ford test-drives the funky new Kia Soul, Jonny presents his pick of the best budget cabriolets, and Tim Shaw reveals how the crumbling economy equals big savings on new vehicles. Olympic cyclist Bradley Wiggins meets Jason at 'Fifth Gear's' velodrome, Tiff pits Renault Mégane hatch against a Caterham CDX sports car, and Vicki demonstrates the racing capabilities of the BMW 330d. Away from the track, Tim delves into the murky world of car crime, Jonny gives a consumer review of the new Ford Ka, and Tom enlists the help of a Guns 'N' Roses tribute band to push the Fiat Qubo to the limit.

Gold-medal-winning sailors Sarah Ayton, Sarah Webb and Pippa Wilson race the Ferrari F430 Scuderia, Tiff test-drives the new Farbio GTS 400, and Vicki reviews the small but chic Alfa Romeo Mito. Plus, Tim's consumer review centres on the diesel-versus-petrol debate, and there is a "Fifth Gear" shootout with a difference.

Vicki meets Charley Boorman for some four-wheeled fun, Jonny familiarises himself with the Honda Insight's green credentials, and Tiff indulges in a classic shootout featuring some hot hatches from the 1980s. Also, Jason zooms in on the Ford Focus RS, Jonny tries to make a quick buck from a rust bucket at an auto-parts jumble sale, and Tim reviews speed-camera alerting systems.
They won gold in Beijing, but how will the three blondes in a boat handle a Ferrari and Jason Plato? Then, get a stomach-churning taste of the fastest motorsport on Earth.
Vicky is at the Frankfurt headquarters of the Mini Dakar rally team where she gets stuck into three of the toughest jobs in motorsport. Plus, Jason road tests a Lamborghini.
Jonny heads to the mecca of driving: the Indianapolis 500. Meanwhile, Vicky visits a state-of-the-art laboratory to see why it's important to change a car's engine oil.
Jonny conducts a jumbo-sized test of the brand new Range Rover Sport. Meanwhile, the team find out if the new Seat Leon is the best sporty hatchback you can currently buy.
Former marine sniper Aldo Kane teaches Vicky the techniques of special forces driving. Then, Jonny checks out a modified home version of a Capri that will challenge a Nissan GTR.
Features Karina Rodriguez vs. Daiana Torquato in a rematch for Invicta FC Flyweight Championship, plus more 🥊 [MMA] MMA action from Kansas City, Kan.

Jed is shocked when he receives news that his multimillion-dollar bank account has been overdrawn by $34 million.
The Clampetts, under the noxious influence of J.D. Clampett, impostor and unemployed actor, go to Hollywood.
Mrs. Drysdale, giving a lavish garden party, finds to her horror that she is losing her guests to the Clampetts.
Jed decides that his tomboy daughter Elly, who has taken up motorcycle riding, needs a mother to make her a lady.
The Clampetts try to participate in some of the more civilized pleasures of Beverly Hills.
The Clampett family is somewhat befuddled when they receive lavish Christmas presents that all seem to come from Mr Drysdale.
An Australian banker sends Drysdale a kangaroo as a joke, and Granny thinks she has discovered a giant jackrabbit.
A beauty-contest winner from the hills and her father come to visit Jethro with marriage on their minds.
Backwoods freeloader Lafe Crick lingers on at the Clampett mansion as an unwanted guest in search of an easy fortune.
Elly May decides to enter a beauty competition to become the queen of Beverly Hills, with some help from Miss Jane and the Drysdales; when Granny hears about the race, she wants to enter as well.
An Easterner swears revenge for the death of his father, a drunk that a Cartwright killed in self-defense.
Hoss falls prey to a beautiful woman with a gambling addiction and refuses to believe she's only interested in his money.
Maud Hoad leads her revenge-seeking family against Joe, who was forced to shoot treacherous Jeb Hoad.
Little Joe and Hoss are mistaken for gunmen while in a small Texas town; they find themselves in the middle of a dangerous feud between two families.
A newlywed on his honeymoon falls for a phony gold-mine swindle.
A Congressional candidate is encouraged to go to the Chicago World's Fair as the man with the longest beard in the world.
A woman is not pleased by the attentions of a drunk, but she's even less happy when Faro Bill kills the man.
U.S. settlers arrive in Mexican-controlled California and clash with the resident Hispanic families.
New sheriff Pat Garrett embarks on a mission to capture the infamous outlaw Billy the Kid.
The daughter of a California ranch owner discovers a lost fortune after his death.
Three telegraph workers fall for a dance hall queen.
When Alex Todd discovers there's money to be made delivering the mail, he starts a subscription mail service and takes letters to the gold camps for miners starving for news from home.
Author Bret Harte arrives in the West, where the colorful residents inspire his story, "The Outcasts of Poker Flat."
A man must transport 500 mail-order brides from Boston to the state of Washington.
In 1846, American forces move northward, leaving sparsely manned Los Angeles an inviting target to the Mexicans.
The story of Harvard's stately elm tree.
A woman reforms herself in Tombstone.
A boy (Julian Dennison) and his foster father (Sam Neill) become the subjects of a manhunt after they get stranded in the New Zealand wilderness.

A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.
A successful writer (Greg Kinnear) tries to reconnect with his two children (Lily Collins, Nat Wolff) after his divorce.

After Regina Lampert (Audrey Hepburn) falls for the dashing Peter Joshua (Cary Grant) on a skiing holiday in the French Alps, she discovers upon her return to Paris that her husband has been murdered. Soon, she and Peter are giving chase to three of her late husband's World War II cronies, Tex (James Coburn), Scobie (George Kennedy) and Gideon (Ned Glass), who are after a quarter of a million dollars the quartet stole while behind enemy lines. But why does Peter keep changing his name?

New Orleans ad executive Marley Corbett (Kate Hudson) is a free-spirited woman who embraces her easy sexuality, shuns commitment, and gains support and strength from a close circle of friends. Then Marley learns she has terminal colon cancer. Despite her determination not to be tied down in a serious relationship, Marley finds herself falling in love with her handsome doctor (Gael García Bernal), even as her health slowly deteriorates.
The age-old middle class male struggle; how to prepare for a blizzard; an application for parenthood.
A divorce; the correct way to have an exit interview; the disappearing friend act.

A man (Steve Buscemi) employed as a clown and his sidekick (Peter Dinklage) try to find a kidney donor for the son of a bail bondsman (David Proval).

En la noche de la familia, el equipo que haga la mayor cantidad de pasta fresca para el servicio de cena de esa noche gana un día de diversión en el muelle de Santa Mónica. Un accidente envía a un concursante al hospital.

Los aspirantes a chefs compiten para crear la mejor pizza gourmet, tras lo cual el equipo ganador disfrutará de una comida gourmet en Santa Bárbara y el equipo perdedor tomará y entregará pedidos de pizza.
Los chefs deben atender a un grupo de adolescentes cuando una quisquillosa joven de 16 años pide una celebración de cumpleaños de fantasía.
El chef Ramsay realiza una prueba de sabor con los ojos vendados para ver quién puede distinguir la carne de cerdo del pollo y las patatas de la polenta.
Los chefs deben crear cuatro platos con 20 ingredientes. Un médico acude a la cocina cuando un miembro del equipo corta más que la comida.
Los equipos deben preparar platos en una carrera de relevos. El equipo ganador se lleva un día de diversión bajo el sol. El equipo perdedor debe limpiar todo el restaurante. Un chef es eliminado.
Los equipos intentan atrapar a cerdos para obtener los ingredientes escritos en sus collares. El equipo ganador recibe un día de balneario mientras los perdedores tienen que bañar a los cerdos.

Los competidores restantes deben preparar platillos usando cinco salsas clásicas, la holandesa, bechamel, demi-glacé, velouté y tomate. El equipo que más impresiona a Gordon se ganará un viaje a un pub al estilo británico y un equipo de trastes.
A cada participante se le pide preparar un sándwich gourmet original; un cliente descontento discute con el chef Ramsay durante la cena; Ramsay cambia de equipo.
Se pide a cada participante preparar un original sándwich gourmet; un cliente discute con el chef Ramsay durante el servicio de la cena; Ramsay cambia los equipos.

Los concursantes participan en un reto de pruebas a ciegas. El equipo ganador recibe un viaje a Sea World, mientras los perdedores se encargan de los quehaceres de la casa. En la noche, los equipos crean menús originales.
Un ingrediente hace que algunos concursantes se quebranten; los equipos se unen para completar un servicio durante una cena teatro.
Los chefs deben impresionar a Ramsay con un plato perfecto.
Los chefs debe crear un delicioso plato que cuesta $10 o menos; los concursantes continuamente cambian estaciones durante el servicio de cena.
Los concursantes enseñan a unos solteros sin experiencia en la cocina cómo preparar un rape. A un concursante se le acusa de sabotaje.
Ramsay prueba la habilidad de los chefs de identificar sabores e ingredientes pidiéndoles recrear una de sus especialidades; un participante se siente abrumado.

Holli y Jay se disputan la final de temporada. Los enamorados se enfrentan. Jay usa las creaciones que guardó para este momento. Holli no sabe qué preparar porque nunca pensó llegar a la final. Los platillos serán evaluados por chefs de Inglaterra.

Dieciséis chefs preparan sus platos de autor en el primer desafío de la temporada; un concursante se apresuró a la sala de emergencias; los invitados comienzan a salir cuando el servicio de cena se retrasa; un participante es eliminado.
Los 14 chefs restantes reciben una lección sobre preparar sushi de Masaharu Morimoto de Iron Chef antes de hacerlo ellos mismos. Un competidor en particular parece que no tiene éxito.
Ramsay ayuda a los dueños gemelos de un restaurante italiano en Eagle Rock, California.
Ayudando a un restaurante en dificultades en Pasadena, California.
Ramsay viaja a Nueva Orleans para mejorar un restaurante cuya calidad se ha venido a menos debido a su decoración y menú desastroso.
El Chef Ramsay visita a los dueños de los restaurantes de Mojito, The Junction (alias Flamangos) y Bazzini.
El chef Ramsay visita restaurantes a los que ayudó en el pasado (Lido, Anna Vincenzo, Le Bistro) para comprobar cómo han evolucionado y si han seguido sus consejos.
El chef Ramsay viaja a Nueva Jersey con la esperanza de ayudar a los dueños del restaurante Blackberry's a mejorar su servicio y la calidad de su comida.
Chef Ramsay visita Leone's, un restaurante italiano en Montclair, N.J., con la esperanza de evitar el cierre del negocio.

Dos equipos se combinan en uno, y a cada chef se le da un ingrediente principal y se le pide que cree un plato adecuado al paladar del chef Ramsay. Durante el servicio de la cena, los chefs tienen dificultades para llevar la comida a los clientes.

Los chefs se enfrentan al reto de enseñar a amas de casa a preparar una comida gourmet. Los chefs Mark Peel y Ben Ford invitan al ganador del reto a un curso individual. Los chefs luchan por equilibrar una docena de aperitivos, entrantes y postres.
An old comedian literally dies on stage during a performance.
Dr. Blake is drawn into a difficult and troubling investigation when a life model is found murdered at the start of a painting class.
When a priest is found dead in his confessional from suspected bee stings, Blake investigates in his characteristic style.

When a family is found slain at the breakfast table, Dr. Lucien Blake can't put his finger on what is wrong with the scene; Jean's wayward son returns unexpectedly and causes quite a stir in Blake's household.
After finishing a rowing race, a winning team member dies after being thrown into Lake Wendouree during celebrations.
A businessman goes into hiding after his assistant is killed.
When a school's headmaster is found dead in his office, Blake's investigations stir up intrigue and demons from the past.
In a Rome racked by chaos, Lorenzo and Clarice scramble to safeguard peace; Savonarola preaches to a growing flock back in Florence.
Ardinghelli turns up the pressure on the Medici; Lorenzo brings together Botticelli and da Vinci, and Bruno visits his family.
The heart has been torn out of the Medici family; after all the painful sacrifices suffered to realize a dream, one life-or-death decision remains.
Cosimo is forced to take control when his father, Giovanni, dies suddenly; his first action is to take over the family bank.

Successful podcast host Samantha Desouza is passionate about music but cynical about love. That starts to change when she meets Jake, a charismatic and charming new caller whom she tries to help with a problem.

Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.
Abandoned by their mother and rejected by a cousin, four children turn up at their cantankerous grandmother's (Anne Bancroft).
A priest (Tommy Lee Jones) and the girlfriend (Annette O'Toole) of a stabbed artist tie the murder to married art-gallery owners.

Buck is a big-hearted dog whose blissful domestic life gets turned upside down when he is suddenly uprooted from his California home and transplanted to the exotic wilds of the Alaskan Yukon in the 1890s. As the newest rookie on a mail-delivery dog sled team, Buck experiences the adventure of a lifetime as he ultimately finds his true place in the world.

Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.
After noticing her swamp nest is missing an egg, an angry crocodile stalks college students (Mark McLachlan, Caitlin Martin, Chris Solari) on a houseboat for spring break.
Sailors go to sea to hunt for a prehistoric shark, previously thought to be extinct.
A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).
A deaf woman is stalked by a killer in her home.

Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.
Members (Charisma Carpenter, Corin Nemec) of a reality TV show investigate a supposedly haunted house.
An actress (Samantha Eggar) escapes from an asylum to attend her husband's (John Vernon) casting session for starlets.

A writer and his secret lover spend time at a remote cabin in the Appalachian Mountains to work on a horror novel. They learn several boys have gone missing, and after the writer's lover also disappears, he tries to solve the mystery.
(1959) A busboy is embraced by the beatnik art community when he develops an impressive but morbid method of sculpturing. With Dick Miller, Barboura Morris, Anthony Carbone.

Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.
Tennison investiga la muerte del gerente del exclusivo Club Huntington.

Arrestan a una mujer, acusada de haber asesinado a su mejor amiga, pero Barnaby duda de su culpabilidad. Aunque las pruebas en su contra sean sólidas, no estaba en absoluto obsesionada con el esposo de la amiga, como la acusación sostiene.

La batalla de sexos de Broughton termina cuando la anciana feminista Mildred Danvers es asesinada volviendo de su casa de la infancia. Mientras Barnaby investiga, el misógino Rev. Gantis recibe un disparo en la cabeza.
Sídney y Nigel buscan la mitad desaparecida de un par de anillos que garantizan la felicidad para siempre.
Un hombre descubre un antiguo pergamino que podría conducir hasta la corona perdida de Brian Boru, el último rey de Irlanda.
Un mago (estrella invitada Shaun Smith) envía a Sydney (Tia Carrere) a localizar unas joyas que pertenecen a la familia real de Hungría. Con: Christien Anholt, Lindy Booth y Jeff Pustil.

Sídney y Nigel son perseguidos por unos asesinos y corren por las catacumbas parisinas para encontrar una botella de vino muy especial — una que podría contener las joyas de la corona francesa extraviadas.
El mentor de Sídney muere antes de recuperar un cáliz extraviado con poderes mágicos y Sídney decide continuar con su búsqueda.
Sídney y Nigel deben autentificar un medallón de 1307 de Jacques de Molay y encontrar la espada invencible de un maestro de los Caballeros Templarios.
El escritor Eric Dalt sospecha que su novia es una vampiresa, y él necesita la ayuda de Sídney para romper el hechizo.
La búsqueda de Sídney para limpiar el nombre de su abuela descubre una intriga internacional y provoca la búsqueda de una invaluable tiara rusa.

Sídney y Nigel se dirigen a Nepal para recuperar el legendario cuenco de limosnas rebosante de Buda, con el propósito de entregárselo a los aldeanos que están construyendo un santuario al Buda original.
Un hombre contrata a Sídney para encontrar la pistola adornada con diamantes de Al Capone, con la esperanza de limpiar el nombre de su abuelo.
La madre de Martín regresa a Portwenn; preguntas sobre el asbesto causan el pánico; Bert tiene una pregunta para Jennifer.

Jane Tennison regresa a Southampton Row para dirigir una investigación sobre el asesinato de un niño pequeño.

Dena Thompson targets, defrauds and attacks the men in her life before deciding to murder her husband.
After her ex moves on, Brenda Delgado masterminds a murder-for-hire plot to end his new relationship.
From October 1989 to April 1991, Wolfgang Schmidt murdered five women and an infant; the area where some of the crimes took place leads to a second moniker, "the Beast of Beelitz."
Laura Al Shatanawi disappeared, and detectives uncovered the tragic truth behind her husband Hassan.
Nick sets out to investigate the Haunted Hill House in Mineral Wells, Texas, a sinister location where hundreds of people have left with mysterious bite marks.

Nick spends forty-eight hours inside a haunted clinic using new equipment to see if he can communicate with the entities that seem to be going out of their way to scare and sometimes physically lash out at the living.
A first date becomes part of a deadly criminal trap.
The investigation of a missing mother's case exposes a calculated attempt to hide murder in plain sight.
Former law enforcement officer, Courtenay Savage, pled guilty to second-degree attempted murder; Lorri Worley stabs son-in-law to death.

The 1993 murder of 19-year-old Dennis Brooks, Jr; a husband shot to death in 2007 due to an argument.

Rumors that Mark may be mixed up with thieves shake Lucas.
A poisonous snake gives a prisoner his chance to escape.
Lucas' lust for revenge nearly ruins his life.
Lucas uses a bullet as evidence to convict a crooked gambler.

A new bank in North Fork is in danger of being robbed.
Mark tries to play Cupid for his father and a pretty young stranger who arrives in town.

After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.
Detective Philip Marlowe becomes embroiled in an investigation with a wealthy family in Bay City, Calif., after a beautiful blonde hires him to find her former lover.

Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.

College dropout Steve Jobs (Ashton Kutcher), together with his friend, technical whiz-kid Steve Wozniak (Josh Gad), sparks a revolution in home computers with the invention of the Apple 1 in 1976. Built in the garage of Jobs' parents, the device -- and the subsequent formation of Apple Inc. -- have changed the world for all time. Though he is viewed as a visionary, Jobs' tenure as Apple's leader is a rocky one, leading to his eventual ouster from the company he co-founded.

In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. Marshall travels to conservative Connecticut when wealthy socialite Eleanor Strubing accuses Black chauffeur Joseph Spell of sexual assault and attempted murder. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty.

The vegetable garden is at its peak now and as well as harvesting, Monty has a look at how his autumn crops are faring as well as giving tips on how to keep the garden looking at its best. There's also a passionate grower in London who uses every available space in his garden to grow a vast range of vegetables.

Monty Don has advice on how to successfully store an apple crop so it will last through winter and explains why he thinks it high time wall flowers came back into fashion. With tomatoes now over, Monty clears his greenhouse and plans for next year by planting garlic in the vegetable garden. Monty has tips and ideas for planting up garden pots to provide a focal point over the winter months, Rachel visits the tulips of Keukenhof, Joe visits Esther Rantzen's much-loved garden, and Carol visits Glebe Cottage.

With the arrival of October, it is time to start thinking about getting some onions and garlic in the ground, and Monty Don shares his secrets on how to get a successful crop. They are on the hunt for some seasonal inspiration for their new garden and what better place to look than RHS Rosemoor.

Monty Don prepares the flowering borders for winter and makes a bonfire, Carol celebrates our berry-laden hedgerows, and Rachel visits Julian Clary in his garden.

Monty revels in the roses in his garden, harvests honey from his bees and gives advice on the maintenance of hardy geraniums as well as planting others for summer ground cover. Rachel de Thame shows how the most ordinary of spaces can be transformed by adding seasonal containers.

Monty plants for pollinators in the Wildlife Garden and trims his box topiary cones. He also takes succulent leaf cuttings and continues the summer veg harvest. Meanwhile, Carol Klein visits stunning Italian-influenced gardens in Gloucestershire.

Charge your glasses as Joe Swift visits a 'drinkable' allotment in London where much of the produce is grown to make beer, wine and cider. In the first of a five-part series about botany, Carol Klein looks at the capsules of potential that herald the start and end of most plants' lives: seeds.
